actually_additions.name: Actually Additions
actually_additions.description: "Use the Atomic Reconstructor and the Empowerer to turn minerals into powerful crystals that allow the creation of useful machines for processing and sorting items, lasers for wirelessly transporting energy, items and fluids, renewable oil to generate power, and much more."

advanced_generators.name: Advanced Generators
advanced_generators.description: This perk provides a mental compendium of blueprints for creating machines and devices from the Advanced Generators mod for Minecraft, along with basic skills and deep insight into energy-generation technology and its applications. Basically, this perk makes it easier to tweak various generators you know how to build, or to find ways to connect some machines to generators, even when such connections are usually incompatible with the machine in question. You know how to think about and generally solve such problems.

almost_unified.name: Almost Unified
almost_unified.description: This perk is inspired by the Almost Unified mod for Minecraft. You gain exceptional expertise in the field of material science, along with keen intuition and a supernatural advantage when working on replacing the materials in your creations with similar ones. If you don't have access to some exotic metal, you might figure out a special alloy from things you have access to use instead.

applied_refined_storage.name: Applied Refined Storage
applied_refined_storage.description: You have access to all blueprints, a theoretical base, and the skills to create and utilize concepts from Applied Energistics and Refined Storage mods and thier various addons. Conversion of matter and energy into digital form for storage, transportation, retrieval, and even processing - these are main themes of the mod. However, as you go further from the main theme of the mod and towards the addons, things become harder and more vague to understand and create reliably.

ars_nouveau.name: Ars Nouveau
ars_nouveau.description: "Ars Nouveau is a magic mod inspired by Ars Magicka that allows players to craft their own spells, create magical artifacts, perform rituals, and much more." You gain the necessary magical abilities to use and create things from this mod, along with basic blueprints, general theory, and talent to quickly progress along this path. Including addons to the mod.

astral_sorcery.name: Astral Sorcery
astral_sorcery.description: "Astral Sorcery is a magic mod focused around harnessing the powers of starlight and the constellations." You gain the necessary magical abilities to use and create things from this mod, along with basic blueprints, general theory, and talent to quickly progress along this path. Including addons to the mod.

better_dimensions.name: Better Dimensions
better_dimensions.description: If you can build portals into the Nether and the End, you now can modify them to lead into their modded versions instead. You can mix and match different combinations of mods, such as Better Nether, to extensively modify each portal and the world on the other side. However, there is only one version of a dimension for each modified portal decided by the moment you firstly created specific variation of the gates. It takes time and resources to modify a portal, and you should be able to build vanilla Minecraft portals in the first place for this ability to work. Additionally, you have extensive and in-depth knowledge about all things from different mods to change the Nether and the End. You know materials, structures, creatures, flora, dangers, and useful tricks.

better_questing.name: Better Questing
better_questing.description: There are many modpacks with some sort of quest system or book. Now, you are capable of creating personal, soul-bound quest books for people. One person can only have one such book, and it cannot be destroyed by usual means because it is a projection of their inner world. It contains unique and dynamically updating quests for each person. Finishing quests from the book allows one to receive thematic rewards. However, what kind of quests and rewards one gets depends a lot on what kind of person they are: what they want, what they believe, what they know, etc.

biomancy.name: Biomancy
biomancy.description: You have access to blueprints, knowledge, and the necessary magical ability to make devices and machines from the Biomancy mod.

blood_magic.name: Blood Magic
blood_magic.description: "Blood Magic is an arcane art that is practiced by mages who attempt to gather a vast amount of power through utilizing a forbidden material: blood. Even though it does grant a huge amount of power, every single action that is performed with this volatile magic can prove deadly. You have been warned." You gain the necessary magical abilities to use and create things from this mod, along with basic blueprints, general theory, and talent to quickly progress along this path. Including addons to the mod.

botania.name: Botania
botania.description: You gain access to magical abilities required to create items and structures from the Botania mod. You also gain basic theoretical background, starting blueprints, and the ability to explore more content of this mod through acts of creation, experimentation, and research. Progression and content also include some addons to the mod, but the further you go from the original theme, the more vague and tedious things become.

builders_might.name: Builder's Might
builders_might.description: You have access to powers inspired by a player character from the Minecraft game. You have an inventory, can craft and gather resources with incredible speed and efficiency, and are capable of imbuing built structures with the ability to defy gravity (until they are disturbed too much). You also have enhanced physical capabilities and faster healing without scars, at the cost of increased hunger while healing or performing above human limitations. You can even respawn after death once every 24 hours in your last place of sleep, if its still intact, accessible and your soul is intact.

charging_gadgets.name: Charging Gadgets
charging_gadgets.description: This is a very simple mod that adds a single block - the charging station. It is basically a full Tinkertech device, capable of recharging almost any other item from Minecraft mods, and it can even be tweaked/modified to charge other unrelated items. You don't know how it works, but you are sure it shouldn't work so well with such a simple design. On the other hand, it's an easy solution for recharging whatever devices you might have on hand. Maybe researching the thing in depth might help you to figure some little things out...

cheap_storage_solutions.name: Cheap Storage Solutions
cheap_storage_solutions.description: You have the ability to create chests, drawers, and other vessels to store an impossible quantity of items. Some of these are good at storing only objects of a specific type, while others can be filled with anything (which can lead to sorting problems). It includes some tools to assist with sorting and devices inspired by mods like Storage Drawers, Sophisticated Backpacks and Iron Chests allowing you to experiment with many functions. However, this perk is essentially tinkertech on maximum settings. Maybe later, you'll be able to create actual 'bigger on the inside' boxes without fiat reality warping enforcing things to just work.

crating_book.name: Crating Book
crating_book.description: You have access to a mental compendium containing blueprints for all craftable items from the Minecraft game. It doesn't grant you skill or knowledge of the intricate inner workings of what you build, nor does it include variations of the same blueprint - just a list of specific items you know how to craft. It provides step-by-step instructions, images, and parameters to keep in mind. It doesn't give you skill or ability to use your creations, nor does it grant access to brewing, enchanting, or other supernatural capabilities. You know the specific recipes, but you lack magic and skill.

create.name: Create
create.description: You have access to all blueprints, expertise, and skills to create and use devices from the Create mod for Minecraft and several famous addons for it. It's mostly about mechanical devices, factories, and some tinker-bullshit stuff here and there. Addons on the list include: Steam 'n' Rails; Crafts & Additions; Big Cannons; New Age; Enchantment Industry; Utilities; etc. It takes more time and effort to explore addons to the original: further from the main theme - the harder and more vague things become.

dark_utilities.name: Dark Utilities
dark_utilities.description: "The Dark Utilities mod adds many new items and blocks that expand upon the vanilla game. This mod aims to be useful in a wide range of circumstances while also adding fun and interesting mechanics." You gain the ability to build all devices from this mod and know how to use them. It's really easy to 'tinker' with this technology.

desertification_infection.name: Desertification 'Infection'
desertification_infection.description: This perk allows you to generate the Infectious Desert biome from Minecraft Desertification mod, transforming the area a few kilometers around you.It will spread slowly afterward, but the speed and effectiveness depend on the nature of the place, including flora, fauna, and the resistance of materials and details of the geography. You can hold this effect in storage until you find a suitable place to target. You can buy this perk multiple times, with a 300 CP discount after the first purchase, stacking these held activations of the ability to use later. The first purchase of the perk grants you encyclopedic knowledge about the Infectious Desert nature and contents.

dis-enchanting.name: Dis-Enchanting
dis-enchanting.description: This perk gives you the ability to create and operate devices or machines for dis-enchanting work. You now have a way to recover enchantments from enchanted objects or books. It is mostly inspired by the mod of the same name as the perk. This works best for Minecraft-style and closely related types of enchanting. It is basically useless for other situations.

doggy_talents_next.name: Doggy Talents Next
doggy_talents_next.description: "This mod aims to create Harmony between the dogs and the player throughout the game. Imagine playing a Piano Concerto, you as the pianist and the dogs as the orchestra. When the two sounds are being played, it creates harmony, which our ears love so much. Thus, the orchestra doesn't overwhelm but empowers the pianist. The mod is and will be designed along that principle. The dogs should accompany the player well while not becoming overpowered in the context. Although when on-demand, sufficient abilities should be granted to them, they should be required to work to achieve those. And you, the responsible owner, should help them." You have special talent to make content from this mod reality.

doing_cool_stuff_with_pressurised_air.name: Doing Cool Stuff With Pressurised Air
doing_cool_stuff_with_pressurised_air.description: You gain access to blueprints for craftable items from the PneumaticCraft mod and significant talent in pneumatic technology overall. It doesn't include much actual practical skill but does provide education on pneumatic systems and their applied uses.

draconic_evolution.name: Draconic Evolution
draconic_evolution.description: This perk gives you knowledge, blueprints of craftable items, and skills to create and utilize things from the Draconic Evolution mod. It includes many high-tier items and is quite resource-intensive. It's more of a magitech creation capability. Don't accidentally explode yourself and your neighbors.

dunegon_artefacts.name: Dunegon Artefacts
dunegon_artefacts.description: You have the ability to craft and use all artifacts and consumables from the Minecraft Dungeons game. It provides knowledge about the usage and functions of each artifact/consumable, but not actual blueprints or theories. This is mostly tinker-bullshit.

dungeon_armory.name: Dungeon Armory
dungeon_armory.description: You have access to a mental compendium containing blueprints to create all craftable weapons and armor from the Minecraft Dungeons game. You also have a basic degree of skill to actually use your creations. Although, it might be problematic to craft/use some stuff without access to specific magics.

dungeon_enchanting.name: Dungeon Enchanting
dungeon_enchanting.description: This perk gives you the ability to use magic to do Minecraft Dungeons-style enchanting. It provides a few specific recipes, some basic theory, and expertise in the field. It works much better with the Vanilla Enchanting perk present but functions somewhat without it.

ender_io.name: Ender IO
ender_io.description: This perk gives you access to blueprints of all craftable items from the Ender IO Minecraft mod, as well as general theory and basic skills to utilize devices from this mod.

ensorcellation.name: Ensorcellation
ensorcellation.description: This perk gives you the ability to use magic for Ensorcellation mod enchantment art, along with talent in this craft and scholarly intuition to actually apply enchanted items in correct or unusual ways. However, if you don't have access to Vamilla Minecraft Enchanting, your creations inevitably will be tinkertech, and your knowledge will have holes in it. You still can create things, just with limitations.

evilcraft.name: EvilCraft
evilcraft.description: This perk gives you supernatural capabilities, basic knowledge, and starting blueprints to explore and utilize content inspired by the EvilCraft mod for Minecraft. You gain one Dark Gem from this perk for free, know how to use it in a ritual to obtain a special book.

ex_nihilo.name: Ex Nihilo
ex_nihilo.description: You are capable of creating anomalous tools inspired by the Ex Nihilo Minecraft mod and its various addons. It basically allows you to create seemingly simple machines/tools and utilize them to produce resources literally from nothing. Not a lot, and with many caveats, but now you can scramble some little bits of needed materials even in the middle of nowhere, where access is limited to only scraps and dirt.

extended_crafting.name: Extended Crafting
extended_crafting.description: "Extended Crafting adds more ways to craft items, more items to craft with, and more utilities for crafting. The mod doesn't do much on it's own and is intended to be configured heavily. All the recipes and settings should be changed to fit the progression of the modpack it's in and how the modpack developer wants it to be used." This perk grants great knowledge of extended crafting methodology, along with ability to utilise supernatural advantage, as you design and apply modifications for blueprints you already know. It also includes blueprints to create basic machinery from the mod. Essentially, it lets you change how you craft things and find new ways to do so, using what you already know and have.

extensive_automated_mapping.name: Extensive Automated Mapping
extensive_automated_mapping.description: You have an ability, which is an amalgamation of functions from several minimap mods such as Xaero's Minimap or JourneyMap. This mental power gives you a customizable map that automatically updates, detects and categorizes creatures around you, and provides information like the time and other details. You can even create waypoints, but you don't have access to any fast travel functions.

extreme_reactors.name: Extreme Reactors
extreme_reactors.description: This perk lets you build giant reactors (small by real reactor's standarts) to harness the power of the atom and mighty turbines to turn steam into energy. It mainly includes blueprints, a deep understanding with extensive expertise in maintenance and proper usage of this kind of technology (mostly specifically these reactors), and some required background theoretical information.

forestry.name: Forestry
forestry.description: You gain access to content inspired by Forestry for Minecraft. You can create, use, and even modify things from this mod and its various addons. It doesn't provide a lot of knowledge, but it offers a lot of pure capability. Includes skills of a supernatural beekeeper!

fungal_infection.name: Fungal Infection
fungal_infection.description: This perk allows you to spawn active Fungal Infection bioweapon from Fungal Infection:Spore Minecraft mod. It will spread slowly afterward, but the speed and effectiveness depend on the nature of the place, including flora, fauna, and the resistance of materials and details of the geography. You can hold this effect in storage until you find a suitable place to target. You can buy this perk multiple times, with a 300 CP discount after the first purchase, stacking these held activations of the ability to use later. The first purchase of the perk grants you encyclopedic knowledge about the Fungal Infection. You are also immune to the infection.

gate_making.name: Gate Making
gate_making.description: You have the skills, theoretical knowledge, and actual capability to build functional portals into the Nether and the End, even if the world you are currently in cannot usually access these dimensions. However, you cannot build any custom variations of portals.

immersive_engineering.name: Immersive Engineering
immersive_engineering.description: You have access to blueprints of all craftable items, expertise to create and operate machines and devices from the Immersive Engineering mod and its various popular addons. It also provides you with an equivalent of a high-end professional education in the area of engineering by 20th-century standards. Addons are more vague, the further away they are from original mod.

immersive_portals.name: Immersive Portals
immersive_portals.description: You have the power to manipulate and create portals, cut doors into other accessible dimensions, and modify existing portals. This power is inspired by the Immersive Portals mod for Minecraft. You can do everything this mod allows, but with some additional possibilities and more extensive, detailed implications of carving space in this way. Be careful. It might give you some intuition and feedback, but the power is not foolproof.

improvable_skills.name: Improvable Skills
improvable_skills.description: This perk gives you access to the skill tree from the Improvable Skills mod for Minecraft. You can obtain points to 'learn' new effects and abilities via living through unique and/or interesting experiences. What counts as a 'suitable experience' depends on your current abilities and present experiences. As a consolidation price, you gain one point to spend after buying this perk and receive a random accessible skill from the tree each month.

industrial_craft.name: Industrial Craft
industrial_craft.description: You have access to blueprints, knowledge, and basic skills to create machines and devices from the Industrial Craft mod, its different versions, and addons. The more you stray from the original mod's theme and into addons, the harder it becomes to make sense of things.

iron_jetpacks.name: Iron Jetpacks
iron_jetpacks.description: You can build and expertly use devices from the Iron Jetpacks mod. They are full-blown tinkertech machines, mostly without any actual theory or reasonable explanation of how they work.

its_gold_in_here.name: It's Gold in Here!
its_gold_in_here.description: When exploring new places in person, you have a chance to find some unique materials/resources from the Mythic Metals and the Gobber mods for Minecraft. Even if it doesn't make much sense to find them there, and they definitely weren't there before you explored the area. But this only happens in new places you explore in person. It is proportionally less effective the more you already know about the location before exploration: the more you know, the worse the effect. It can be toggled on or off or set to work partially, causing some materials to appear while others do not. Materials are only found in places similar to where they usually generate or are found in the game. You can roll and buy this perk multiple times, with a discount up to 200 CP. This will allow you to include other materials in generation from the Minecraft perks you currently possess - you can choose one. If you don't have any, you can choose to make this perk select a random source for you. from all Minecraft mods with materials/resources content.

jack_of_basic_trades.name: Jack of Basic Trades
jack_of_basic_trades.description: You have basic skills and knowledge in many areas: farming, animal rearing, riding, mining, map-making, fishing, etc. Whatever the player can do in the game, you can also do on a basic level. For example, it won't be too hard for you to chop down a tree, build a simple hut, or hunt down some wild animals. However, you are still an amateur in all these areas. Still better than having nothing.

jewelry_and_baubles.name: Jewelry and Baubles
jewelry_and_baubles.description: You become a highly skillful jeweler with the special ability to create various magical pieces of jewelry and utilize them effectively. This perk includes content from mods: Iron's Gems 'n Jewelry, Jewelry (RPG Series), and Magical Jewelry, along with their add-ons.

just_enough_items.name: Just Enough Items
just_enough_items.description: This thinker power gives you the ability to obtain a mental blueprint to craft whatever object you are holding in your hands or currently exploring. It provides the simplest, most straightforward version of the blueprint first and uses your other perks and knowledge to provide it. More complex items will require more time to obtain blueprints, or the power might not be able to give you a recipe if it’s unfeasible to create the item with the abilities you currently have. Creating a working instance of the object using the obtained blueprints can result in some new variations of the original blueprint, especially if you're lucky or if the power learns something important in the process. This is great for reverse engineering.

large_ore_deposits.name: Large Ore Deposits
large_ore_deposits.description: This perk gives you the power to perform a special ritual. By sacrificing targeted material (seed) you have and a few other items (depending on the main material), you can force the generation of a large ore deposit underground at your position, containing raw ore inspired by the sacrificed seed. The more esoteric and unique the material, the more elaborate, complex, and costly the ritual becomes. You can only use this ritual every 24 hours, and it can fail if you are underprepared or make a mistake.

mekanism.name: Mekanism
mekanism.description: You have access to blueprints of all craftable items, a theoretical base, and basic skills necessary to create machines and devices from the Mekanism mod and its various popular add-ons. This perk includes the contents of all Mekanism mod modules: Additions, Generators, and Tools. However, as you move further from the main theme of the mod and toward the add-ons, things become more complex and less straightforward to understand and create reliably.

mining_dimension.name: Mining Dimension
mining_dimension.description: You are capable of creating a mystical portal leading into a dimension inspired by Aroma1997's Dimensional World mod for Minecraft. The contents of the world on the other side of the portal depend on the other perks you already have at the moment of portal creation. When you build the portal, the dimension is actualized, and new perks obtained after this point will not affect the contents of the mining world. However, you can roll and buy this perk several times (costing you only 350 CP) and gain the ability to create another variation of the dimension, separated from the first one and working by the same perk-content rules.

mining_gadgets.name: Mining Gadgets
mining_gadgets.description: "Sometimes you want a quick change of pace when it comes to mining. Pickaxes. Drills. Bores. Robots. Quarries. These are all great options. Now you can use lasers too if you want." You have blueprints to craft such tools and great skill in using them in practice. You can easily go full tinkertech with this perk.

modded_ores.name: Modded Ores
modded_ores.description: Congratulations! After acquiring this perk, you can force Minecraft-style ore generation into any landscape you target once. Within a radius of one thousand chunks (around 1,600 meters) around you, different ores from one mod of your choice, for which you possess the perk, will appear underground. Depending on the mod you have chosen for the specific generation effect, the ores can be very different. All ores have unique properties inspired by their source mod. You can hold this effect activation for as long as you want, until you find a place you like to target and use it. This perk can be rolled multiple times, stockpiling activations in storage. You decide which mod will be used to source the types of ores at the moment of casting the effect. Each additional roll after the first purchase will be discounted to 350 CP.

modular_force_field_systems.name: Modular Force Field Systems
modular_force_field_systems.description: This perk gives you blueprints and skills to create, use, and maintain a variety of devices from the Modular Force Field Systems mod for Minecraft. It can be built relatively cheaply if you really go full tinkertech. However, you have almost no knowledge about how these forcefields function on fundamental level.

modular_machinery.name: Modular Machinery
modular_machinery.description: "A modpack-maker toolset to create custom, massive, unique and complex machines and recipes from scratch" This perk grants great knowledge of modular machine-making methodology, along with ability to utilise supernatural advantage, as you design and build modular modifications for creations you know how to make. Heavily inspired by the mod of the same name.

mystical_agriculture.name: Mystical Agriculture
mystical_agriculture.description: You gain a supernatural ability to craft and grow magical plants to produce resources from the Mystical Agriculture mod and its various addons. It mainly includes items from Minecraft and various mods for the game. You have a great talent for gardening and intuition for magical flora.

ore_generation.name: Ore Generation
ore_generation.description: Congratulations! After acquiring this perk, you can force Minecraft-style ore generation into any landscape you target once. Within a radius of one thousand chunks (around 1,600 meters) around you, different ores from vanilla Minecraft will appear underground - ranging from coal and iron to amethyst geodes and redstone. All ores have unique properties inspired by their source game. You can hold this effect activation for as long as you want, until you find a place you like to target and use it. This perk can be rolled multiple times stockpiling activations in storage. Each additional roll after the first buy will be discounted to 200 CP.

oritech.name: Oritech
oritech.description: You gain access to blueprints for craftable items, methodologies, and levels of scientific knowledge to create, maintain, and use devices from the Oritech mod for Minecraft.

potion_rings.name: Potion Rings
potion_rings.description: "This is a really simple mod, which adds rings that, when equipped on the baubles slot, provide a permanent potion effect. Wearing two of the same ring upgrades that effect to level two". You are capable of creating and enchanting rings that grant potion effects while worn. It specializes in Minecraft-style potions and works best with vanilla ones. Potions from other sources will generally not work with this method, and a few rare that do may cause dangerous failures during the creation process. This perk does not give you the ability or skill to make potions; it only enables you to embed their effects into rings.

projecte.name: ProjectE
projecte.description: You are capable of creating and using a special supernatural tools and devices to exchange one material for another. The core concept of the mod, EMC (Energy-Matter Currency), is a value assigned to items and blocks representing their energy cost or worth. Players can store, transfer, and convert EMC to facilitate item duplication or transmutation.

psi_technology.name: Psi Technology
psi_technology.description: "Psi is a magical tech spell programming mod inspired by Mahouka Kokou no Rettousei. Don't worry if that doesn't make any sense." You gain the ability to use devices from this mod, along with blueprints for all craftable items, an extensive theoretical base, and some talent for utilising this kind of magical technology.

rftools_dimensions.name: RFTools Dimensions
rftools_dimensions.description: Congratulations! You've got access to a number of tinkertech machines to create your own custom dimensions! Yes, they are stupidly energy-hungry and tedious to program. Yes, they require you to periodically maintain and watch closely over their work... But you can have your own procedurally generated ocean of liquid gold, or maybe an infinite field of giant truffles!

scape_and_run_parasites.name: Scape and Run: Parasites
scape_and_run_parasites.description: This perk allows you to generate Parasite Infected Biome from Scape and Run: Parasites Minecraft mod, transforming the area a few tens of meters around you.It will spread afterward using mechanics inspired by the mod. You can hold this effect in storage until you find a suitable place to target. You can buy this perk multiple times, with a 300 CP discount after the first purchase, stacking these held activations of the ability to use later. The first purchase of the perk grants you encyclopedic knowledge about the Parasites nature and contents. You are also immune to the infection.

sculk_horde.name: Sculk Horde
sculk_horde.description: This perk allows you to spawn active Ancient Sculk Node with awaken Gravemind from the Sculk Horde Minecraft mod. It will spread slowly afterward, but the speed and effectiveness depend on the nature of the place, including flora, fauna, and the resistance of materials and details of the geography. You can hold this effect in storage until you find a suitable place to target. You can buy this perk multiple times, with a 300 CP discount after the first purchase, stacking these held activations of the ability to use later. The first purchase of the perk grants you encyclopedic knowledge about the Sculk Ecosystem. You are also immune to the infection.

silent_gear.name: Silent Gear
silent_gear.description: "The mod focuses on tools, weapons, and armor (collectively called gear). Recipes are modular, down to each individual piece used in crafting. Possible combinations for each gear type are practically unlimited." You have ability to create different gear from the mod Silent Gear and its various addons. This perk's ability has supernatural component.

simple_generators.name: Simple Generators
simple_generators.description: This perk gives you the ability to create different machines from the Simple Generators mod for Minecraft. They generate power, obviously. However, these generators are mostly tinkertech, and you gain great skill and a supernatural advantage from this perk only while working on the generators from this perk: building, maintaining, using, and connecting them. Although, it still gives you some useful and unique theoretical knowledge.

simply_skills.name: Simply Skills
simply_skills.description: This perk gives you access to the skill tree from the Simply Skills mod for Minecraft. You can obtain points to 'learn' new effects and abilities through good fights and via living through unique and/or interesting adventures. What counts as a 'good fight' and a 'suitable experience' depends on your current abilities and present experiences. As a consolidation price, you gain one point to spend after buying this perk and receive a random accessible skill from the tree each month.

simply_swords.name: Simply Swords
simply_swords.description: You gain exceptional smithing skills focused on the creation of items from the Simply Swords mod for Minecraft. You also have great talent at wielding all types of weapons presented in the Simply Swords mod (including unique), but no actual skills to use them.

spartan_weaponry.name: Spartan Weaponry
spartan_weaponry.description: This is an extension of blueprints for weapons, tools, and other items from vanilla Minecraft. You have enough knowledge and skills to craft items from the Spartan Weaponry and Spartan Shields mods. You also have the equivalent of extensive training to use each weapon from the mod with an above-average degree of finesse, along with great talent to easily advance these skills toward mastery.

structural_know-how.name: Structural Know-how
structural_know-how.description: You are a skillful architect and builder. You have expertise in building all Minecraft structures that generate naturally in the game and have blueprints of them. You can use your skills to design your own projects and bring them into reality as a professional builder.

tasty-tasty_addon.name: Tasty-Tasty Addon!
tasty-tasty_addon.description: You are a skilled cook and have a mental compendium of all recipes and blueprints for tools and devices from Farmer's Delight, Cooking for Blockheads, Pam's HarvestCraft, and other similar 'tasty' mods, along with their many variations and addons. You also possess just enough basic skills to obtain all the ingredients for your cooking.

technically_infinite_dimensions.name: Technically Infinite Dimensions
technically_infinite_dimensions.description: This perk gives you the ability to modify existing Nether portals to access variety of random dimensions from the April Fools Minecraft snapshot 20w14∞. You don't know what awaits you on the other side before checking things out. It can be good, it can be bad, but mostly weird, random, and chaotic. The beauty of wild magic!

tempad.name: Tempad
tempad.description: This perk gives you access to blueprints for craftable items from the Tempad mod, along with specks of basic theory and skills to actually use all the devices provided by this perk. It is mainly about creating portals and instantly traveling within the world.

terrafirmacraft.name: TerraFirmaCraft
terrafirmacraft.description: You gain the knowledge and skills needed to progress through the entire tech tree from the TerraFirmaCraft mod for Minecraft and its various addons. You can start with nothing but nature around you and still create many useful things to start a civilization.

tetra.name: Tetra
tetra.description: You gain access to all the necessary skills and knowledge to modify tools and weapons in the style of the Tetra mod. This can even be applied to things beyond the scope of this mod, if you are creative.

thaumcraft.name: Thaumcraft
thaumcraft.description: This perk gives you the ability to use Thaumcraft-style magic and conduct unusually fast and efficient research into the contents of this mod. The contents include various versions of the mod and famous addons for it as well. You can awaken ability to use magic in other people with this perk and some ingenuity.

the_aether.name: The Aether
the_aether.description: This perk gives you the ability to build a working Aether portal into the dimension of the same name, even if it shouldn't work in your current world. This dimension is inspired by various versions of the Aether mod for Minecraft. You gain basic knowledge about things on the other side, some information about materials and structures of interest, and great adaptability to high altitudes. You require to have glowstone or some really close-enough material to build this portal.

the_twilight_forest.name: The Twilight Forest
the_twilight_forest.description: You have the ability to create a portal that leads to the newly generated Twilight Forest dimension from the mod of the same name. The contents of the dimension include all connected addons of the original mod. You have general knowledge about important aspects of the dimension: its dangers, useful materials, flora and fauna, and mystical laws.

the_undergarden.name: The Undergarden
the_undergarden.description: You are able to craft a special tool and activate a portal with it, which will lead to the newly generated Undergarden dimension, named after the same. You have encyclopedic knowledge about this new world and the basic skills needed to survive. You are also immune to all potential diseases this place might contain.

thermal_expansion.name: Thermal Expansion
thermal_expansion.description: This perk gives you access to all blueprints, expertise, and skills to create and operate machines from the Thermal Expansion Minecraft mod. It includes all main modules of this mod: Foundation; Cultivation; Dynamics; Innovation; Integration; Locomotion. It also includes various famous addons to the mod, but exploring these directions is more difficult, takes more time, and can be rather tedious. As you go further from the main theme of the mod and towards the addons, the tasks become harder and more vague.

theurgy.name: Theurgy
theurgy.description: You gain knowledge and ability to utilise mechanics and create mahines/devices/materials from the Minecraft mod Theurgy and its various addons

tinkers_construct.name: Tinker's Construct
tinkers_construct.description: You gain the needed knowledge, blueprints of craftable items, skills, and abilities to produce items and machines from Tinker's Construct mod and its various addons and extensions. This power is partly magical, allowing you to bring out unique and exotic functionalities from even seemingly mundane materials. It's even possible for you to discover some new properties and combinations of materials that are not included in the original mod and its various addons.

vanilla_brewing.name: Vanilla Brewing
vanilla_brewing.description: This perk gives you the ability to use magic for Minecraft-style brewing, along with talent in this craft and scholarly intuition - covering the general theory behind the process and how to actually apply potions in correct or unusual ways. It doesn't provide you with specific recipes but allows you to explore, test brews, and tweak existing blueprints in your possession beyond what the original game lets players do. You need this to use brewing stand effectively.

vanilla_enchanting.name: Vanilla  Enchanting
vanilla_enchanting.description: This perk gives you the ability to use magic for Minecraft-style enchantment art, along with talent in this craft and scholarly intuition - covering the general theory behind the process and how to actually apply enchanted items in correct or unusual ways. It doesn't provide you with specific recipes but allows you to explore, test, and apply enchantments to different items, and to tweak existing blueprints in your possession beyond what the original game permits. You need this perk to use the enchanting table effectively.

vanilla_golems.name: Vanilla Golems
vanilla_golems.description: You have a supernatural ability, theoretical background knowledge and actual skill at building golems. Although, you only have blueprints for types present in the game. They listen to your orders and are generally aligned with you, although they are not very smart beyond their primary function and can be tricked easily. If they don't have any orders - they just follow their basic innate programming or become idle.

vein_mining.name: Vein Mining
vein_mining.description: This striker power is inspired by various mods, which allow players to mine extensive quantities of material at once. You can start chopping down a tree, activate this ability, and the whole tree will be disassembled into the needed materials much quicky by propagating effect. However, you require specific tools for each type of material/structure. It also makes you hungrier faster, and tools will break and proportionally use more energy/fuel to achieve efficient excavation for bigger quantites of material. Complex structures made from many different materials cannot be reliably broken down with vein mining and there is size limitations for each excavation. If you have a personal inventory, mined resources will go there. If not, they will be neatly piled nearby.

villager_trades.name: Villager Trades
villager_trades.description: You gain an average level of skill in haggling and primitive commerce. Additionally, when you roll this perk, you gain average skill and knowledge in any one villager profession of your choice. You can pay an additional 100 CP or wait for this perk being rolled again to acquire more areas of expertise until you have them all. The list of villager professions includes: Armorer, Butcher, Cartographer, Cleric, Farmer, Fisherman, Fletcher, Leatherworker, Librarian, Mason, Shepherd, Toolsmith, and Weaponsmith.

waystones.name: Waystones
waystones.description: This perk adds the ability to craft and enchant waystone pillars (and all accessories to use them) that you can return to once they've been activated. Either through a Warp Scroll, a rechargeable Warp Stone, or by using an existing waystone to hop from one to the other. You have the necessary skills and abilities to create things, but do not actually know how they work.

what_are_we_looking_at.name: What Are We Looking At
what_are_we_looking_at.description: This thinker power gives you some basic information about the things you directly look at. It mainly provides details such as health, name, type of the item, the level of tools needed to harvest it effectively, and so on. These are some short and useful pieces of information to know, but nothing deep.

You can hold off releasing the bag into the world for as long as you like. They work like normal plants if left to grow in the wild. However, if someone or something plays an active role in cultivating and tending to this Amaranth plant, it starts to grow abnormally fast (maximum speed of 7 days to fully grow in perfect conditions). source_celestial_something_-_11_the_bind.source: Celestial Something - 11  The Binding of Isaac
source_celestial_something_-_11_the_bind.description: Perks from Celestial Something - 11  The Binding of Isaac.

a_dollar.name: A Dollar
a_dollar.description: "$$$" This perk gives you 100 Pennies. In this case, Pennies are imaginary and immaterial unspecified currency, which you can materialize into actual money at any moment. It works only one way - Pennies into material currency, but be sure - now you have some sizable sum in your metaphorical (and soon literal) pocket!

a_pony.name: A Pony
a_pony.description: "Flight + Dash Attack." This stick horse item grants flight and increases speed passively. Upon active effect use, you charge in the direction the pony is facing, providing a degree of invulnerability during the charge and dealing damage to enemies hit. Active use of this item has a cooldown. The wielder gains basic knowledge about the usage and functionality of the item when it is equipped by them.

anarchist_cookbook.name: Anarchist Cookbook
anarchist_cookbook.description: "Summon bombs." This is an actual Anarchist Cookbook and can be read like any normal text. Although it is more in-depth and factual, it also provides a slight passive boost to learning and using the knowledge contained within. The active effect spawns seven primed explosive devices (of reasonable power) at random points nearby the user, which explode in a few seconds. It has a cooldown and grants general knowledge about the effects of the book and how to use it to the person who equipped it.

best_friend.name: Best Friend
best_friend.description: "Friends 'till the end." This small doll item, upon active use, spawns a decoy that explodes after 5 seconds. Enemies are attracted to the decoy and lose track of the user. This effect has a cooldown. The decoy looks like a person lying on the ground but can have different appearances and illusionary details to better attract enemies.

blood_rights.name: Blood Rights
blood_rights.description: "Mass Enemy Damage at a Cost." This perk grants you a straight razor artifact with special properties and basic knowledge of how to use it. When used to cut yourself, it deals consistent damage and doesn't cause bleeding. This action will inflict damage on everyone you perceive as enemies around you (mostly in the form of internal trauma and cuts). It doesn't have any special effects when used to cut other creatures - just an exceptionally durable and always sharp razor. It has a cooldown for its main effect and provides feedback about it to the current user.

bloody_gust.name: Bloody Gust
bloody_gust.description: "May your rage bring haste." Each time you take damage in a fight, it boosts your speed and agility temporarily until reaching a certain maximum. There are six 'stages' to the effect. It decays rapidly outside combat.

book_of_revelations.name: Book of Revelations
book_of_revelations.description: "Reusable soul protection." This item, upon use, grants one soul heart. Soul hearts work like a form of absorptive armor, taking damage instead of hurting your body. Depending on the severity, a different number of metaphorical hearts will be lost to absorb the damage. You can have a maximum of 12 soul hearts. There is a small chance of encountering the Harbinger boss attacking you shortly after using the book. The wielder of the book gains knowledge of how to use it and a general description of its effect. The active effect has a relatively long cooldown. You can also read it as a normal book.

book_of_shadows.name: Book of Shadows
book_of_shadows.description: "Temporary invincibility." This item creates a protective shield, nullifying almost all types of damage for 10 seconds upon activation. The wielder of the book gains knowledge of how to use it and a general description of its effect. The active effect has a cooldown. You can also read it as a normal book.

brimstone.name: Brimstone
brimstone.description: "Blood laser barrage". This perk lets you shoot blood laser beam from your mouth that pierces through enemies and obstacles in its path and deals high damage. Can only be fired after a short charge-up period. This perk can be purchased twice to get upgraded version.

candy_heart.name: Candy Heart
candy_heart.description: "Power of Love." This perk grants you incremental upgrades to a few randomly chosen physical stats after healing from wounds. It only works if the healed wound was severe enough and the healing process was fast enough (like regeneration). The upgrades are tiny but permanent.

contagion.name: Contagion
contagion.description: "Outbreak!" The first enemy killed in a battle releases a gas cloud that poisons nearby enemies in small radius. Affected enemies will also release gas upon death, spreading the effect. This gas is not permanent, existing only for a short moment.

cracked_orb.name: Cracked Orb
cracked_orb.description: "Shards of Knowledge." Each time you take damage exceeding a certain severity, you gain one of the following boons: useful insight about your surroundings; closed/blocked passages nearby being opened; or useful items being uncovered and brought to your attention from nearby area. It is mostly random but depends on what is around you and the situation you are in.

dead_eye.name: Dead Eye
dead_eye.description: "Accuracy Bbrings power!" This perk increases damage each time an enemy is hit by your attack. The damage bonus resets when you miss a shot. This effect has a certain bonus limit and does not work for some types of attacks (like lasers). You can toggle the effect on and off.

empty_heart.name: Empty Heart
empty_heart.description: "It Multiplies." This perk lets you completely heal from crippling and other negative side effects of wounds and ailments if your health falls below a certain threshold. It is as quick as your normal recovery speed. For example, it can fix wrongly fused bones after fracture recovery, but not smaller scars left behind by this wound. Or you can regain your lost eye: fully or partially, depending on your health status.

epiphora.name: Epiphora
epiphora.description: "Intensifying tears." Shooting in one direction increases your rate of fire until the cap is reached. As soon as you change direction or stop shooting, the rate of fire resets to its normal amount. The effectiveness of the effect depends on the type of attack used. You can toggle this ability.

forget_me_now.name: Forget Me Now
forget_me_now.description: "I don't remember..." This perk gives you a special pill. It lets you "reset" your day once - right after taking it, traveling back 24 hours. You bring items on your person, memories, and other perks into the past with you, along with your current physical state. For instance, if you are wounded at the moment of pill effect activation, you will still be wounded afterward. This perk can be purchased multiple times. Remember, traveling back doesn't mean things will happen in exactly the same way. You gain general knowledge about the pill effect from the perk.

glowing_hourglass.name: Glowing Hourglass
glowing_hourglass.description: "Turn back time." Upon active use of this item, time gets rewound back toward the last bifurcation point in your timeline - such a moment at which grant changes happen due to small choices made by you. Usually, it brings you back a few minutes, but it can also be an hour or even up to a whole day in the past. Only user's mind travels back; nothing else does. This item can be used three times, and repeated use cannot take you further back than 24 hours from the previous use. This means you cannot use it twice in quick succession to travel more than 24 hours back. The only way to recharge this item is by rolling and purchasing this perk again (for half price), but hourglass can only store up to three charges. The wielder gains basic knowledge about the usage and functionality of the item when it is equipped by them.

guppys_collar.name: Guppy's Collar
guppys_collar.description: "Eternal life?" This perk grants a permanent 50% chance to respawn with a highly diminished state of health after death. You are not wounded after respawning, just fragile.

holy_light.name: Holy Light
holy_light.description: "Holy death shot." This perk allows you to either: add a chance to fire a 'holy shot' - a modification of your ranged attack that creates a damaging light beam in the area if it hits an enemy; or apply this effect to your attack intentionally, but with a specific cooldown between each application. You can toggle the effect of this perk, or even turn it off.

holy_mantle.name: Holy Mantle
holy_mantle.description: "Holy shield." This perk grants an invisible shield/barrier that negates the first instance of damage taken. It takes some time to recharge and cooldown is lower when outside immediate danger or battle. It works against most types of damage, but not all of them.

incubus.name: Incubus
incubus.description: "Dark Friend." This perk allows you to spawn and dismiss a demonic familiar that floats nearby you and shoots ranged attacks identical to your current ones in terms of damage, rate of fire and special effects. For example, if you are using a Tommy gun with tungsten bullets, the Incubus will mimic this ranged attack.

keepers_sack.name: Keeper's Sack
keepers_sack.description: "Balls." Each time you purchase something from a willing trader, you receive a random permanent physical stat upgrade proportional to your spendings. It works better for large one-time expenditures made in person, where actual goods are being bought and spent sum is big enough to trigger the effect. It's very finicky about what counts as a "purchase" and cannot be cheated, not easily.

monstrance.name: Monstrance
monstrance.description: "Purifying light." This perk gives you the ability to turn on an aura, which deals damage to enemies inside it. The closer they are, the more damage is dealt. Effect looks like a brightened area around you and a dim light.

pjs.name: PJs
pjs.description: "You feel cozy." This perk grants you 4 'soul hearts' and fully restores your health. Soul hearts work like a form of absorptive armor, taking damage instead of hurting your body. Depending on the severity, a different number of metaphorical hearts will be lost to absorb the damage. You can have a maximum of 12 soul hearts.

playdough_cookie.name: Playdough Cookie
playdough_cookie.description: "Tasty rainbow". This perk let's you turn your shots multicolored. Each color comes with a different status or tear effect applied to the shot. Colours and effects for each projectile is random, when active.

pyromaniac.name: Pyromaniac
pyromaniac.description: "It hurts so good +5 bombs". This perk grants immunity to explosion damage and fire damage. It also causes explosions to heal you. More exotic flame/explosion effects might still affect you negatively or interact weirdly with this power.

red_candle.name: Red Candle
red_candle.description: "Flame on." This magical item can be used to shoot a blob of strangely persistent fire. It will burn in the targeted location for some time, scorching the surrounding area, and can be moved by strong enough wind or force while it lasts.

rock_bottom.name: Rock Bottom
rock_bottom.description: "It's only up from there". This perk revents your physical attributes from falling below their highest values reached. Attributes continue to be calculated normally internally. Rather than use your current stats, items and effects will impact the same way they would as if you did not have Rock Bottom. Temporary buffs work normally, though they may make reaching new best values harder after the buff has worn off. Stat penalties are accounted for, causing increased difficulty of reaching new best values.

spoon_bender.name: Spoon Bender
spoon_bender.description: "Homing shots." This perk grants you the ability to apply a TBOI-inspired homing effect to your ranged/projectile-based attacks. It causes them to bend toward the closest enemy nearby. You don't have manual control over who/what is targeted and should instead try to position yourself in the right way to influence it. This effect works a bit differently for various types of ranged attacks you might use.

stop_watch.name: Stop Watch
stop_watch.description: "Let's slow this fown a bit..." This perk slightly increases your movement and reaction speed. It alters perception to make things move only at 80% of their speed from your point of view, without losing any understanding of events happening around you. It takes some time for the brain to adapt to this new reality. This power can be toggled.

the_candle.name: The Candle
the_candle.description: "Reusable flames." This magical item can be used to shoot a blob of blue fire, which disintegrates things on contact and diminishes quickly. It works better against living and organic matter. A wisp of blue fire is hard to move after it has been thrown.

the_compass.name: The Compass
the_compass.description: "The end is near". This perk gives you a mental compass in the back of your mind, which points you toward places of interest nearby in your current location. It might take some time to figure out what the Compass is showing you, but behind all the symbols it uses, there is logic and system.

the_hourglass.name: The Hourglass
the_hourglass.description: "Temporary enemy slowdown." You gain an hourglass, which can be used to slow down everyone you perceive as enemies around you for eight seconds. It has a cooldown. The item also provides feedback about the recharge status and knowledge of the Hourglass use to the holder. The effect is not temporal in nature, but inertial/kinetic - doesn't slow perception of time.

the_wafer.name: The Wafer
the_wafer.description: "Damage resistance." Most sources of harm that would cause more damage than a certain threshold will only deal a fraction of it, which is a constant value. For example, being shot would only leave a bad bruise and maybe some broken bones, depending on where the hit landed. Remember, the effect is less effective or even doesn't work on some forms of damage.

white_pony.name: White Pony
white_pony.description: "Flight + holy death". This stick horse item grants flight and increases speed passively. Upon active effect use, you charge in the direction the pony is facing, providing a degree of invulnerability during the charge, dealing damage to enemies hit and also creating damaging beams of light. Active use of this item has a cooldown. The wielder gains basic knowledge about the usage and functionality of the item when it is equipped by them.

yum_heart.name: Yum Heart
yum_heart.description: "Reusable regeneration." This soft heart-shaped object is tasty. A bite taken from it causes the user to regain some health almost instantly, but then the effect goes on a cooldown, and you cannot bite it again until it recharges. It doesn't heal status effects, but it is very effective against wounds and physical consequences of things like toxins. It cannot heal cancer or genetic damage, but somewhat effective against more physical parts of brain and radiation damage. The wielder gains basic knowledge about the usage and functionality of the item when it is equipped by them.

source_celestial_something_-_12_fear_and.description: Perks from Celestial Something - 12 Fear & Hunger.

alchemillia_tome.name: Alchemillia Tome
alchemillia_tome.description: This tome contains three volumes of Alchemillia - a book for beginner, intermediate and experienced level alchemy. It lets one learn and use alchemy skills from Fear & Hunger games, even if it's shouldn't be possible to learn and use in your current world.

artificial_soul.name: Artificial Soul
artificial_soul.description: There are rumours that Bremen experimented with creating artificial souls to power their unholy rituals. If this truly is one of those it could be used to channel otherworldly more efficiently. Reduces Mind cost of skills by 30% (stacks multiplicatively). Can be bought several times.

betels_stone.name: Betel's Stone
betels_stone.description: The ring of a long gone new god Betel. The has magic imbued in it that is constantly leaking from the crystal. Restores 10% Mind every turn (doesn't stack).

blood_sword.name: Blood Sword
blood_sword.description: A sword forged from the blood of Alll-mer. Blood sword is one of the few physical weapons in the game that deals Otherworldly damage

blue_noctuid_necklace.name: Blue Noctuid Necklace
blue_noctuid_necklace.description: Combining the two wings into one makes it a complete moth necklace. The necklace emanates special aura that protects from the otherworldly. Aura that only manifest when one is low on health.

cube_of_the_depths.name: Cube of the Depths
cube_of_the_depths.description: The Cube of the Depths is an eldritch artifact sacred to the God of the Depths. It acts as key to enter Ma'habre within the book. It is also used as a way to travel between the past and present day Ma'habre via the devices located throughout the city of the gods.

cursed_blue_sin.name: Cursed Blue Sin
cursed_blue_sin.description: A fine and light one-handed sword with faint blue carvings. On the hilt there is some writing: "For the sinners." It has an ability to leave a burning effect on an enemy.

engrave.name: Engrave
engrave.description: Engrave a sigil on a party member. The benefit of the sigil varies depeding on the god it belongs to. Historically sigils were carved on the body, but modern practition prefers face sigils. You have enough skill and knowledge to carve and use these sigils consistently.

eye_of_sylvian.name: Eye of Sylvian
eye_of_sylvian.description: Said to be an eye of the older god Sylvian herself. How it could have ended up here is a mystery. You have your doubts. It does seem to boost the recovery effect of healing items and magic... Increases effect of healing items and skills by 50% (stacks multiplicatively). Can be bought several times.

guardian_cameo.name: Guardian Cameo
guardian_cameo.description: A cameo carving of a beautiful woman from a bygone era. The jewel emits strange aura... It is now possessed and grants protection to those in low health.

hungry_and_afraid.name: Hungry & Afraid
hungry_and_afraid.description: You are somewhat of an expert when it comes to dealing with hunger and fear. You don't have actual experience, but you possess many unique practical skills, useful trivia and habits to use when needed. It not only includes things like finding food or knowing how to cook and eat usually inedible things, but also strategies like psyching yourself up to eat something gross or how to use drugs to relieve stress while minimizing the chances of psychological addiction forming. You know various techniques to deal with fear and stress, and have aptitude to deal with feeling of hunger and exhaustion.

leechmonger_ring.name: Leechmonger Ring
leechmonger_ring.description: A heft ring forged by the Hermit Mages of South who dedicated their lives to the God of the Depths Hundreds of years ago. The mages were able to infuse the ring with life draining magic. Restores Body by converting 3% of physical damage dealt to enemy (doesn't stack).

longinus.name: Longinus
longinus.description: The spear that punctured Alll-mer's side as he was chained and crucified. A faint trace of the shadow that was cast away for Alll-mer to reach his ascension. Longinus is one of the few physical weapons in the game that deals Otherworldly damage

medicinal.name: Medicinal
medicinal.description: Sacrifice harvested organs to Vitruvia, the architect of the human body. A sacrifice will cure a corresponding status ailment. Medicinal is based on the law where every action has an equal reaction. You have ability, along with enough skill and knowledge to utilise Medicinal consistently.

miasma.name: Miasma
miasma.description: Miasma is an otherworldly sword that oozes toxic gasses that, at some point of history, was locked away in the dungeons of fear and hunger. The weapon is rumored to house the strength of six men. Despite its impressive might, Miasma's most notable trait is not its power: the sword possesses sentience and can communicate with individuals by projecting a voice into their minds. Miasma employs various tactics to sway its wielders towards committing killing sprees.

nosramus.name: Nosramus
nosramus.description: "You can't tell if they're male or female." Nosramus was the fifth member of the Fellowship of the current New Gods. Nosramus did not ascend like the others in the Fellowship but chose the path of enlightenment instead. They appear after their death with all knowledge and skills intact, along with some of their tools, knowing that they have accepted this second life.

red_virtue.name: Red Virtue
red_virtue.description: A masterfully forged light sword. The sword is very light and so excels in finesse. It is said that Red virtue is one of the two swords forged for the ancient king of Ma'habre. Red virtue is one of the few physical weapons in the game that deals Otherworldly damage.

ring_of_the_still-blood.name: Ring of the Still-blood
ring_of_the_still-blood.description: A ring that is said to make blood still and thus prevent bleeding. There's no way to explain this but magic.

ring_of_wraiths.name: Ring of Wraiths
ring_of_wraiths.description: A ring with a blood diamond embedded on it. The diamond has seen so much death that life force is leaking from it. The priests of Rondon have slaves digging these diamonds no matter the cost. Restores 8% Body every turn (doesn't stack).

ritual_circles.name: Ritual Circles
ritual_circles.description: You have ability, skills and knowledge to create and use ritual circles from Fear & Hunger games. In contrast with circles available in the game, you can do a bit more with functionality of each. Be careful, these circles connect to the divine entities from its source setting and use their authorities, which may bring some unwanted attention and phenomena into your current reality. You are capable of teaching this art to other people, making the practice spread from person to person.

sabbath.name: Sabbath
sabbath.description: To counter the rising threats of the witch and vampire hunts of the 1700s the Vatican city developed this otherworldly sword to be used by the penance knights as their new main weapon. Sabbath is one of the few physical weapons in the game that deals Otherworldly damage.

salmonsnake_rune.name: Salmonsnake Rune
salmonsnake_rune.description: An old relic from northern warrior tribes of Oldegård. The rune is said to contain a soul of a Salmon snake that gives its owner a hardened skin that prevents limb losses, burns and bleeding.

smelter_key.name: Smelter Key
smelter_key.description: A key that has seemingly melt in high temperatures. The key feels heavier than it's supposed to as if something is attached to it. A spirit protects the wearer from fire and flames.

the_darkness.name: The Darkness
the_darkness.description: A living and seeping darkness that attaches itself to whoever dares to touch it and live in symbiosis with it.

source_celestial_something_-_13_custom_t.description: Perks from Celestial Something - 13 Custom Tinker.

aspects_and_essences.name: Aspects and Essences
aspects_and_essences.description: This Tinker ability is all about working with the Essence and Aspects of physical objects and energy. You can build tools to decipher what conceptual components the targeted phenomenon contains, then create a device or method to extract a few highly expressed aspects from the object in the form of essences, and eventually figure out how to apply this essence to other objects. It is very research-intensive and requires one to focus on specific objects, aspects, and use cases each time. However, it allows you to create objects with bizarre properties using relatively mundane items as a source of essence. You can detect, isolate, extract, and eventually apply something like the 'toxicity' aspect from radiation to another device or material. Your usual tinker limitations are slightly lifted.

blackbox_principles.name: Blackbox Principles
blackbox_principles.description: You can apply principles of tinkertech blackboxing to mundane devices and your other creations. You have full control over the degree of blackboxing used and its nature. It can involve simple methods to make your creations resistant to reverse engineering and research by others, or a complete tinkertech-tier blackbox, making the inner workings of the machine practically incomprehensible and impossible for outside observers. However, you need to have some sort of target to apply this tinker power. It can work with a broad variety of creations, but a heavily blackboxed device might affect long-term performance and the ability of others to maintain it in a detrimental way. Different types of targets might also introduce some side-effects to the process. Your usual tinkering limitations are slightly lifted.

bottled_superpowers_for_sale.name: Bottled Superpowers for Sale
bottled_superpowers_for_sale.description: You are a tinker specializing in the creation of Bottled Superpowers. You can create various serums, elixirs, mutagens, and fantastic concoctions to grant supernatural, scientific, eldritch, or any other type of superpower to other people. They can have vastly different sources, methods of operation, and ways of integration. However, all Bottled Superpowers are somewhat random; it's hard to create powerful ones, and some methodologies might cause usual tinker problems in the created powers (such as the need for special maintenance, instability over time, etc.). Your tinker restrictions are partly lifted, depending on the kind of Bottled Superpowers you are making and how or to whom you want to apply them. Advice: don't mix too many powers in one subject; use extensive human trials to get rid of some problematic kinks of your product.

carbon_era.name: Carbon Era
carbon_era.description: You can build things out of carbon extremely well. This is your main material. For instance, you can figure out a way to create a fully functional smartphone, which is made of 98% carbon. Carbon metamaterials, nanostructures, and other exotic applications of the element are your bread and butter. However, you are still limited by what is hypothetically possible, and you need to find inspiration for devices in the outside world and the technology around you. This is a methodology type of tinker power. Your usual tinkering limitations are slightly lifted.

clockwork_mechanist.name: Clockwork Mechanist
clockwork_mechanist.description: This tinker power specializes in clockwork and focuses on designing, building, and manipulating intricate mechanical devices and automata. This expertise allows you to create advanced clockwork machines, precision gears, and complex gear-driven systems. You can craft autonomous clockwork robots, intricate locks and traps, or elaborate timekeeping devices. This focus is really great at working with mechanical energy and its transformations. Methodology and possible devices to create are limited by clockwork theme. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

common_appliances.name: Common Appliances
common_appliances.description: You are a tinker focused on the creation of 'mundane' devices, such as microwaves, freezers, toasters, and similar items. The things you make have the same functionality as their usual non-tinkertech variants, but extended, more efficient and more powerful. You can also attach some exaggerated upgrades to these basic functions if they are thematic - for example, a freezer that can keep perishable items in stasis, or a vacuum capable of absurd levels of suction. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

counter-tinker.name: Counter-Tinker
counter-tinker.description: You are a Tinker focused on countering the works of other Tinkers. You excel at in-depth analysis of the functions and workings of other Tinker-made devices, along with creating the necessary tools to do so. However, your main focus is on creating devices to counter other Tinkertech. You can also create counters to your own creations, but doing so has 'inbreeding' effects - making the counters worse and more dangerous with each generation if you use your own work as inspiration. Unfortunately, you need to observe and research the works of other Tinkers to create anything, though you can still produce most basic tools and sensors within your specialization. Fortunately, you are still free to use counter-devices in any way you want; even if using them for purposes to different than their primary function is less efficient and, in some cases, can complicate maintenance. You can use this power to counter mundane tech, but its effectiveness is inversely proportional to your understanding of the targeted technology, and it generally works less well on non-Tinkertech. Your usual Tinker limitations are slightly lifted. Advice: target eldritch and alien technology.

cozy_solarpunk.name: Cozy Solarpunk
cozy_solarpunk.description: This tinker power specializes in solarpunk and excels at designing sustainable, eco-friendly machinery and innovative devices that harmonize with nature. All equipment within this focus relies on renewable energy sources such as solar, wind, and bioenergy, combined with eco-conscious materials. The development of new devices and techniques is guided by principles of sustainability and ecological balance. Your methodology and creations are limited by the optimistic and environmentally conscious spirit of the solarpunk theme. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

crazy_edison.name: Crazy Edison
crazy_edison.description: As Tinker specialized in Bulbs and Light Sources, you can create exotic illumination devices that produce mesmerizing and unusual effects, such as cooling, color-shifting, X-ray vision, projecting illusions, literal black light, etc. Think of Bakuda, but with bulbs, less destructive and energy intensive effects. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

daily_hyperfixation.name: Daily Hyperfixation
daily_hyperfixation.description: For 24 hours, you gain a random tinkertech blueprint to work on. After 24 hours pass, the new blueprint you can build appears, and the old one disappears. You need to finish your current fixation project to save the blueprint and be able to build it again. If you cannot finish your current blueprint, all completed parts will be converted into inspiration to modify your previously saved blueprints, thematically related to the unfinished creation. You can finish a blueprint by cutting corners, but the saved blueprint will always be of a device you actually completed at the end of the current 24-hour cycle. So if you build crappy version - you get crappy blueprint. Your state of mind, levels of stress and living situation slightly affect what kind of blueprints you gain. Usually you gain blueprints, which are technically possible for your to finish in 24 hours, but not always. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

dakka.name: Dakka!
dakka.description: You are a tinker focused on Firearms and Bullets. You can create guns and ammunition with ridiculous functions and effects, as long as they stay within the concept of 'firearm.' You cannot make pure laser weapons or plasma cannons, for instance. But a machine gun with homing rocket bullets? That is possible! Think of Bakuda, but with bullets and guns instead of bombs. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

darts_and_blowguns.name: Darts and Blowguns
darts_and_blowguns.description: Your tinker power is about the creation of 'poison' darts and pneumatic delivery systems. You can make darts of bizarre designs and imbued with interesting effects. They can be lethal or non-lethal, positive or negative, or serve some other utility (like tracking). But all these effects are chemically based. The other part is delivery systems - blowguns and similiar devices of various designs and levels of sophistication. However, they all use pneumatics to shoot the darts. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

diesel_industry.name: Diesel Industry
diesel_industry.description: This tinker power specializes in dieselpunk and excels at crafting rugged, retro-futuristic machinery and industrial devices. All machinery within this focus utilizes advanced variations of chemical fuel and highly sophisticated combustion engines to achieve its goals. The use of chemical fuel and combustion is a main component of practically all your designs. Your methodology and the devices you create are limited by the dieselpunk theme. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

furry_science.name: Furry Science
furry_science.description: This tinker ability is focused on the furry subculture and draws inspiration for its creations from this theme. You can make various devices inspired by this fandom. It can be something mundane, like an advanced fursuit, or something complicated, like a cloned body of an anthropomorphic animal of your design. However, any creation should be inspired by or closely connected to this specific subculture. Your usual tinkering limitations are slightly lifted. Having familiarity with this community can greatly help you work with this tinker focus.

low-scale_production.name: Low-Scale Production
low-scale_production.description: You can create specialized machines and devices for the refinement of materials and the creation of simple components. They are easy to automate but are very focused on a single task or narrow application. For example, a small furnace that is extremely good at refining copper from scraps and ore, turning it into high-purity ingots, but it doesn't work on any other metal. You need different machine for doing something else. They are also designed to be low-scale, producing small batches of product. You don't really scale up. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

mirrors_and_mirrors.name: Mirrors and Mirrors!
mirrors_and_mirrors.description: You are a Tinker specializing in Mirrors and Reflection. You can create devices to reflect and mirror various effects. For example, you can create a shield capable of nearly perfect reflection of kinetic energy attempting to break through it, or a hologram projector capable of producing a temporarily physical simulacrum of another person under your control. You have all the usual limitations of a Tinker.

origami_master.name: Origami Master
origami_master.description: Your tinker ability is all about producing and folding paper to achieve your goals. It contains three narrow subcategories of things you are good at: Origami, Papermaking, and Scribbling. Origami is all about folding paper into efficient, useful shapes, and it can be used on other materials as well, but it becomes less effective the further the targeted matter is from the type of paper. Papermaking is focused on creating specialized papers for your work: bulletproof paper, hydrophobic paper, fire-resistant paper, etc. Scribbling is a more exotic craft involving inscribing patterns and text on paper to infuse it with unique added properties or to program it to do something (like folding in a specific way with a trigger condition attached). You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

perpetual_motion.name: Perpetual Motion
perpetual_motion.description: You are a tinker capable of creating various perpetual motion machines. Starting from basic classic designs that actually work to produce mechanical energy, and finishing with more esoteric and fundamental approaches made functional. Although, it is generally easier for you to create machines that can generate a relatively small amount of mechanical energy for an unlimited amount of time (not counting maintenance and other tinkertech-related problems). However, if you have a device on hand, it would be easy to adapt your design to power this specific machine. You have a relatively high upper scaling limit. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

projection_crafting.name: Projection Crafting
projection_crafting.description: This unique tinker focus lets you create 'projections' of existing objects via usage of special custom devices. They function like copies of the original device or item, possessing most of its properties and functions (while not being truly material or permanent). For example, you can create a device to project several copies of a lightsaber to use, while keeping the original one safe. Or use something like an addon for the gun to essentially have infinite bullets, using projected matter to refill the gun. However, all projections created this way are connected to the original and cannot exist without it. At higher levels, you might store 'memory' of the original to partially sidestep this issue, but ultimately, any projection will wear out, warp in shape and function, and eventually collapse without an intact and accessible original to pull from. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

pseudoscience_enjoyer.name: Pseudoscience Enjoyer
pseudoscience_enjoyer.description: Your theme and specialty are rather odd - Pseudoscience. Your creations are inspired by and function like various pseudoscientific devices, using the logic and 'knowledge' of different forms of pseudoscience. These devices are perfectly functional for what you create them for, but they are rather weird and make even less sense than usual Tinketech. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

psi_tradeoff.name: Psi Tradeoff
