psi_tradeoff.description: You are a tinker able to create devices that reproduce and simulate various 'psychic' effects. Drawing inspiration from fiction, as well as actual supernatural and magical effects, will help you a lot. However, there is always some tradeoff in using these devices - some kind of mental cost. You can create a small device to achieve telekinetic flight, but at the cost of 4% of your maximum focus while the device is equipped. Or maybe you want to set things on fire with your gaze, but at the cost of permanently burning your own memories in quantities proportional to the complexity and power of the spontaneous combustion you are trying to achieve. Or you might literally spend your 'social battery' to fuel people-targeting psychometry. There is always a tradeoff - always a cost. At least, these devices are much less dangerous when used by you. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

shizotech_fugue.name: Shizotech Fugue
shizotech_fugue.description: On normal days, your tinker power is very good at making simple and robust (by tinkertech standards) tools and stockpiling special materials. But you accumulate charge in this state (which has an upper limit), which you can spend to enter a special kind of fugue. In this state, you turn temporarily schizophrenic and experience heavy hallucinations. What you experience in this state determines what you will build using the materials and tools around you. This fugue is extremely efficient at making you build things, even from subpar materials. It can last up to 48 hours (maximum charge) or until you lose consciousness due to stress and fatigue. In the end, you have some useful and bizarre tinkertech device (or several) with a general idea of what it does, but you need to actually research and test it to figure out the details of maintenance and any special quirks of the created item. The state of your psyche greatly affects the products. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

spider_tinker.name: Spider Tinker
spider_tinker.description: Your tinker focus is all about spiders and their derivative products. You can separate this specialty into three subcategories: Spiders, Products, and Traits. The first is about affecting the actual category of creatures labeled as 'spiders': modifying them, breeding and creating new ones, controlling them, and using them as helpers with tinkertech. The second is all about derivatives: production of various silks, custom toxins, and other spider-related physical materials. The third involves applying the properties of spiders to other things: building primitive spider-bots, creating serums to grant discount Spider-Man powers, etc. This specialty heavily relies on your conceptualization, creativity and knowledge of the theme. Your usual tinkering limitations are slightly lifted.

stone_age_tinker.name: Stone Age Tinker
stone_age_tinker.description: You specialize in the creation of devices, tools, and items from the Neolithic Age and inspired by it. Your material requirements are relatively low and contain a lot of natural, raw materials. Your creations are unusually high quality; they are much more efficient and functional than expected from such seemingly primitive objects. You are capable of creation of non-tinkertech Neolithic items of high quality, but they just very good mundane things. Your usual Tinker limitations are slightly lifted.

sweet-tooth_tinker.name: Sweet-tooth Tinker
sweet-tooth_tinker.description: Your tinker ability is focused on the creation of various sweets to achieve your goals. It contains three broad subcategories of things you are good at: Shaping, Boost and Minions. The first is candy-material science, used to create tools, mechanisms, and devices from sweets with exotic properties. Boost is all about creating sweets that bestow positive or negative effects - temporarily (or permanently, if you try really hard) - on a target. Minions is all about creating sweets golems, animated and life-like creatures to help you with work or fighting. All your creations are technically edible. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

tacticool_attachments.name: Tacticool Attachments
tacticool_attachments.description: You are a tinker specialized in the creation of attachments for other devices. You should research and focus on a specific technological item to start building, testing and improving various add-ons for it, which can extend, deepen, or otherwise upgrade the main or secondary functions of the object. Things like an unusually efficient silencer for your pistol or perhaps a battery attachment to extend your force field charge. However, everything you create must be attached to and be a derivative of another device. Your understanding of the functions of the targeted item is very helpful. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

taxidermy_enthusiast.name: Taxidermy Enthusiast
taxidermy_enthusiast.description: As Taxidermy Tinker you can create strange, animated hybrid creatures and eerie sculptures using preserved animals, bones, and mechanical parts. Your works are often bizarre and unsettling, but not alive. You require organic materials and simple mechanisms, but your creations are short-lived and dependent on available resources. You have problems working with human bodies, or any other materials too distant from 'animal' definition. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

the_art_of_retrofitting.name: The Art of Retrofitting
the_art_of_retrofitting.description: Your tinker ability is uniquely centered around the concept of retrofitting - transforming and upgrading existing devices, structures, and systems into new, more advanced forms. You excel at taking old, outdated, or broken technology and infusing it with innovative modifications, turning it into something far more capable than its original design. Whether it's retrofitting a simple machine to handle complex tasks, upgrading a worn-out device with cutting-edge components, or repurposing old technology for modern use, you thrive on creatively reimagining the potential of what already exists. Your expertise lies in customizing and enhancing rather than inventing from scratch. However, your retrofitting process often results in devices that are unpredictable or temperamental - sometimes working flawlessly, other times malfunctioning in unexpected ways. This can lead to surprising outcomes. The more outdated and old the technology you are working with, the more efficient this ability is. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

think-tanks.name: Think-Tanks
think-tanks.description: Your tinker power is focused on the creation of cloned brains in boxes. You can create copies of brains (yours or other people's), download knowledge, personality, and data into them, then put these brains into jars and force them to think up ideas and solutions for you using various mastering techniques, brainwashing and various similar methods. Completely unethical, and you must ensure from time to time that these brains won't try to betray you by booby-trapping some of their ideas. However, it is really efficient for offloading solution searching and brute-forcing creativity. This specialty doesn't let you create anything else but think-tanks and will oppose you if you try to use it to create something else (like fully functional clones). Although, it includes methods of quickly and efficiently coping results from think-tanks and implanting these ideas into your head. Your usual tinkering limitations are slightly lifted.

tinker_of_escalation.name: Tinker of Escalation
tinker_of_escalation.description: Your tinker power revolves around the concept of Escalation. It allows you to push existing devices and systems beyond their original limits, increasing their power, complexity, and unpredictability. While you can turn simple gadgets into formidable or unstoppable creations, your escalations often cause unpredictable ripple effects in the environment, making your inventions prone to instability or chaos (you are less affected personally). The more pressure is applied from outside, the faster and more effectively your Escalation potential grows and quicker it can be turned into upgrades. However, if you suddenly stop escalating the acceleration 'counter' resets, and all devices built by you begin to malfunction more often, requiring more maintenance and quickly losing their power, potential and danger. This is a methodology-type of tinker power - you need outside inspiration or devices to use as a starting point for the process. You have all the usual limitations of a tinker.

wondrous_metals.name: Wondrous Metals
wondrous_metals.description: As a tinker specialized in fictional metals, you can synthesize such wondrous materials and produce simple objects made from them. You can create tools to actually work with these materials. It is possible for you to create a specific type of mithril, for instance. However, you must draw your inspiration from a particular work of fiction. Some materials are harder to make and use than others, some are more powerful, and some are closer to the original source of inspiration. The intangible value and theme of the fictional work greatly affect the results of your tinkering, as well as depth and quantity of information given about the metal. Your usual tinker limitations are slightly lifted.

source_celestial_something_-_14_miscella.description: Perks from Celestial Something - 14 Miscellaneous Powers.

administrator_engine.name: Administrator Engine
administrator_engine.description: This ability automatically connects to all other perks and powers you have and updates when you acquire new ones. Its primary goal is the management and control of the various effects that powers give you. It grants you the ability to tune and even turn powers on or off, even for ones which usually don't have any means of control. You can preprogram various quick changes to tweak the operation of many abilities at once, giving you more precise control over the abilities you possess and making it easier to monitor what they do and when. Of course, it works a bit differently with different perks and tries to adapt to them. Basically, it just gives a control panel to better monitor and manage your powers.

aspect_loom.name: Aspect Loom
aspect_loom.description: You can unravel matter and energy into thick, colorful threads and wind them into balls that represent aspects of an object. Simply touching your target starts the process. These threads can be stored in a special pocket dimension and accessed at any time. If you haven't altered the threads, you can turn them back into the original objects. The mass, volume, and complexity of the target determine how many threads you obtain and how easy/hard it is to do, but it will always be lesser in mass and volume than the original unraveled object. You can split these threads into more, unraveling the nature of the object into simpler aspects. Using different threads, you can create patterns so that when they are reassembled, the resulting object will be different - made of aspects of your original target and inspired by the new shape. You are an expert in working with threads and possess an unnatural intuition for manipulating aspect threads specifically. Others can also work with these threads and even restore them into objects using the right supernatural energies or abilities, but without your unnatural intuition, it is difficult for them to find effective or useful patterns.

dionysus_ultimate_blessing.name: Dionysus Ultimate Blessing
dionysus_ultimate_blessing.description: You cannot die from overdrinking; at some point, it will stop worsening. Any damage caused by drinking will be healed by a short hangover afterward. You do not suffer from the usual side effects of alcoholism, such as developing a tolerance to alcohol. While you are at least a little bit drunk, you cannot be poisoned by other substances. Your luck slightly increases with how drunk you are at the moment, though there is a limit. You are extremely knowledgeable about cocktails, alcoholic beverages, and how to drink them correctly. You can consume methanol or similar "alcoholic" substances without dying, going blind, or experiencing other severe consequences, but the hangover will be longer and much worse. You can still get drunk, even if other powers prohibit or make it impossible. You can experience degrees of drunkenness beyond what an unmodified human brain can normally comprehend. If you want to get intoxicated from drinking at the moment - you will!

escalating_harm.name: Escalating Harm
escalating_harm.description: Once you land the initial strike on an opponent, your subsequent attacks become increasingly devastating. Each successive blow inflicts twice the damage of the previous one. For example, if your first hit is a minor abrasion, the second strike will be twice as severe, and the third strike will be eight times more potent than the initial wound. However, this escalation can be disrupted if you switch targets or if there is a pause between attacks, causing the damage multiplier to rapidly decrease or even reset. It doesn't work if your first attack didn't deal enough damage and can be interrupted by other exotic effects.

fire_fiends_creation.name: Fire Fiends Creation
fire_fiends_creation.description: You can create free fire spirits or infuse items with them using living things you’ve burned down yourself as the source, from their ashes or by literally dragging specks of ‘inner fire’ from the corpses of your foes. These 'Fiends' need to eat fire or highly flammable materials to survive, but even then, they have limited and usually short lifespans because they age relatively quickly. They are generally aligned with you, listen to your orders and are loyal, but tend to be mischievous and ‘fiery’ in character due to their nature. They live longer when infused into objects, but their effects are less powerful.

fluid_light.name: Fluid Light
fluid_light.description: You are capable of absorbing light with the surface of your body, turning it into a transparent fluid and excreting it from any point on your body. Disturbing this substance causes it to partly revert back into light (for example, by suddenly heating it or punching it hard). This liquid is practically weightless and has very low viscosity. However, you can concentrate more light into the same volume of liquid. Doing so will make it heavier and more viscous, the more light you pack into it. Additionally, disturbing it will produce brighter light with a shorter wavelength. You are good at absorbing visible light but terrible at absorbing non-visible light. There is a limit to how much you can absorb, store, and recycle per unit of time.

just_pop_it.name: Just Pop It
just_pop_it.description: You can cause almost any physical object or part of it to pop, as if it were a balloon - simply by applying enough pressure or using something like a needle. Larger and more massive objects explode with greater power. After performing the 'pop' action, you have a short window of invulnerability to protect you from the explosion itself and some of the shards it produces, but nothing beyond that. You have perfect control over when this ability is active.

metaphorical_flames.name: Metaphorical Flames
metaphorical_flames.description: You can use metaphorical sources of flame inside and around you to fuel your magic. For example, you can use your own flaming rage or fires of will to produce mystic effects, which will make these two 'burn brighter,' but also turn to cold ash more quickly. This means that if you use something like flaming rage or fires of will, your willpower and anger will suddenly be 'brighter' for some time (while they are burning), but eventually they will burn out, leaving behind disinterest, apathy, or something similar. You will have to restore them afterward. So, it's better to use something like potential flames trapped inside gunpowder on your person as fuel, even if it might be less effective or nearly impossible to utilize for certain tasks. Sourcing metaphorical flames requires creativity and thinking. Some sources are easier and better than others for your magic to work and some tasks are better done using specific flames, or some fires might affect the magic in some ways. For example, you cannot use the flames of another person’s rage directly, but if you bait them into focusing their anger on you, it becomes easier to do. Or as another example: using flames of rage is good for doing violent tasks, although it might bleed into your spells and produce some side-effects associated with rage. They are much more pronounced, if the task is already closely related and harmonised with concepts of anger. Although, not everything can be used as a source, because it must be some sort of metaphorical flame or at the very least fuel for it.

mortis_essence_accumulation.name: Mortis Essence Accumulation
mortis_essence_accumulation.description: You have a metaphorical vessel of 'mortis essence' inside your soul. You can replenish this magic by killing or witnessing death personally. You become stronger and can restore powers in places drenched in death or strongly associated with the dead, as recognized by the local population or creatures in the area. You gain more from killing or witnessing the death of someone who resists death or being killed. You also gain more from sleeping or meditating in places associated with the dead. Different creatures, types of death, and locations influence your replenishment. You cannot accumulate too much mortis essence, as it makes you more vulnerable to death: stopping bleeding takes longer, severe wounds are more likely to cause death, you get ill more easily, etc. So, you need to find a way to get rid of the excess or figure out how to block/control automatic replenishment of the essence before it kills you. Mortis essence is strongly aligned with arts related to death and the dead, such as necromancy or burial arts, but is not limited to them.

ocean_of_bouillon.name: Ocean of Bouillon
ocean_of_bouillon.description: You can instantly conjure great quantities of fresh, boiling-hot (or cold, depending on the dish), and delicious soup, broth or stew in any targeted empty vessel. It must be some kind of mundane soup, broth or stew, and you should be somewhat familiar with specific dish to actually summon it. The substance created this way is enhanced to be perpetually hot (or cold, depending on the dish) and fresh until eaten or ruined by external factors (like dirt getting into it). After that, these special properties gradually (or abruptly) diminish and disappear completely. You can instantly fill a cauldron with your favorite stew, definitely a tub, or even the whole room. It just needs to be some non-living vessel with physical access to its insides. There is a limit of how much you can create at once, but its a lot of stew/soup/broth.

oddly_convenient_spare_parts.name: Oddly Convenient Spare Parts
oddly_convenient_spare_parts.description: When breaking down or disassembling something, you can often find spare parts inside, even if there shouldn't be any. While you cannot precisely control which spare part you will get, you can steer it slightly in the desired direction. Repeatedly disassembling and reassembling objects allows you to dupe pieces with each iteration. Although, there are diminishing returns for doing it to the exact same thing over and over again. The terms 'disassembly' and 'something' are quite flexible - breaking rocks with a pickaxe or preparing wood also technically count as disassembling. As a result, you may find yourself with more spare parts or useful items than expected, even in these cases. Very rarely, when searching for space parts, you might discover unique, thematic items related to what you disassembled among spare parts - for example, finding a golden nugget in a piece of rock you broke down, even if it shouldn’t be there. You also have a knack for dismantling objects quickly, safely and carefully. Nothing supernatural though.

resources_conversion.name: Resources Conversion
resources_conversion.description: You have an inventory space size of one cubic meter. You can put resources, materials, and even some components into this extradimensional space with a touch, as long as they are not larger than a cube with a side of one meter. Things inside this space will be converted from one resource into another after specific time passes. How long this takes depends on three parameters: Properties, Composition, and Shape. How different these three between the original target and intended result. For example, you can put one type of steel into this space and turn it into another of your liking in a matter of minutes: one alloy of iron transformed into another. You are only aware of how long the transformation will take after putting something inside the space and choosing end state of conversion. You can eject items at any time (they will remain unchanged if not enough time has passed for full processing) and must do so if you want to change what is currently contained in this cubic dimension (you cannot add stuff, while something is inside). Trying to turn something into a completely different type of entity might take years and even decades to process, which is usually not worth it. Some small amount of material gets lost in the conversion process, proportionally to how much time it took to convert. End result depends on what you are asking this power to do, but cannot be anything but resource, material or component.

tearful_pellets.name: Tearful Pellets
tearful_pellets.description: You possess the ability to project and throw small pellets that burst into a cloud of capsaicin-derived substance, similar to tear gas but potentially more potent. You have control over the volume of gas clouds each pellet produces when you create it and the level of concentration. You are immune to the effects of the tear gas, allowing you to navigate through the cloud unharmed. Pellets do not persist for long - they disappear after some time, if lose contact with you and not being used/destroyed.

transmutative_rise.name: Transmutative Rise
transmutative_rise.description: This ability lets you target matter weighing no more than one kilogram and having a volume of no more than one liter. You must be able to touch this matter and separate it from other things around. This power will, after a few minutes of focus and wait, suddenly add one to the atomic number of each element in the targeted volume. There will be a bit of a glow, and the targeted object will be transmuted. However, there may be some logical, some unexpected and even dangerous consequences (although a bit softened). The time it takes to make transmutation happen is proportional to the atomic number of the targeted elements. For example, you can turn a cube of pure iron into cobalt after focusing this ability on it for twenty minutes and then it will suddenly turn from iron (26) into cobalt (27).Effect of this power mostly creates stable isotopes of an element, if its possible.

wooden_stake.name: Wooden Stake
wooden_stake.description: You possess the ability to rapidly grow and produce dead wood from your own body. This wood can take on various shapes such as beams, stakes, thorns, curved branches, and other pointed objects. You have the flexibility to make them hollow or alter their inner structure or surface for a little while, even making them polished. Your power does not tarnish your clothes or other thin materials around you (if you don't want it to). The wood you create is dark, dense, and exceptionally hard. It is resistant to catching fire, but if it does ignite, it burns rapidly. It is very susceptible to natural decay and rots relatively quickly over time. You have the power to infuse existing or created wood (including alive) with your energy. For instance, you can charge a small piece of wood, throw it, and after a certain time, it will begin to transform into preprogrammed pointed shapes, resembling your own body’s abilities, until the charge is depleted. Alternatively, you can grow wood from other wooden surfaces that you come into contact with. Charged wood, under your control, can be easily broken by you and poses no harm to you.

advanced_autonomous_industries.name: Advanced Autonomous Industries
advanced_autonomous_industries.description: This perk includes blueprints for all craftable items and machines from the Advanced Autonomous Industries mod, along with its various modules and addons. It also provides you with just enough scientific knowledge to somewhat understand your creations, as well as the skills to utilize, build, and reliably maintain this kind of technology.

biters_and_other_pests.name: Biters and Other Pests
biters_and_other_pests.description: You have a mental compendium of research on various enemies from the Factorio game, including the Space Age expansion. You also possess tactical skills to fight and exploit these different creatures. You are talented at researching alien hostile life and producing countermeasures against such biological dangers.

blue_science.name: Blue Science
blue_science.description: You gain the ability to gradually acquire both theoretical and practical knowledge of Factorio-style chemical science and production. You start with basic stuff from the perk and need to build and use devices, as well as proactively utilise chemical science to push this ability further and further until you reach a limit of the perk decided by Factorio game content.

bobs_assembling_machines.name: Bob's Assembling Machines
bobs_assembling_machines.description: Gives you the ability to build and use all new tiers of assembling machines added by the Bob's Assembling Machines mod for Factorio. This perk stacks and synergizes greatly with other Bob mods. However, it is more tinkertech on its own, but becomes less so as more Bob mods are stacked on top of each other. The more of them you have, the more capable you are of discarding the tinkertech approach in favor of true technologies provided by all related perks.

bobs_electronics.name: Bob's Electronics
bobs_electronics.description: Gives you the ability to create a whole new electronics production chains inspired by Bob's Electronics mod for Factorio. This perk stacks and synergizes greatly with other Bob mods. However, it is more tinkertech on its own, but becomes less so as more Bob mods are stacked on top of each other. The more of them you have, the more capable you are of discarding the tinkertech approach in favor of true technologies provided by all related perks.

bobs_greenhouse.name: Bob's Greenhouse
bobs_greenhouse.description: Gives you the ability to build a greenhouse from Bob's Greenhouse mod for Factorio. This is a pretty bizarre and unnaturally effective structure to produce wood - at least not magical types. This perk stacks and synergizes greatly with other Bob mods. However, it is more tinkertech on its own, but becomes less so as more Bob mods are stacked on top of each other. The more of them you have, the more capable you are of discarding the tinkertech approach in favor of true technologies provided by all related perks.

bobs_logistics.name: Bob's Logistics
bobs_logistics.description: Gives you the ability to build all logistics related things added by the Bob's Logistics mod for Factorio. This perk stacks and synergizes greatly with other Bob mods. However, it is more tinkertech on its own, but becomes less so as more Bob mods are stacked on top of each other. The more of them you have, the more capable you are of discarding the tinkertech approach in favor of true technologies provided by all related perks.

bobs_materials.name: Bob's Materials
bobs_materials.description: This perk provides a mental compendium and blueprints to utilize resource processing and material production from Bob's Metals, Chemicals and Intermediates, and Bob's Ores mods. This perk stacks and synergizes greatly with other Bob mods. However, it is more tinkertech on its own, but becomes less so as more Bob mods are stacked on top of each other. The more of them you have, the more capable you are of discarding the tinkertech approach in favor of true technologies provided by all related perks.

bobs_mining.name: Bob's Mining
bobs_mining.description: Gives you the ability to build and use all new mining machines and tools added by the Bob's Mining mod for Factorio. This perk stacks and synergizes greatly with other Bob mods. However, it is more tinkertech on its own, but becomes less so as more Bob mods are stacked on top of each other. The more of them you have, the more capable you are of discarding the tinkertech approach in favor of true technologies provided by all related perks.

bobs_modules.name: Bob's Modules
bobs_modules.description: Gives you the ability to make and use all modules added by Bob's Modules mod for Factorio. This perk stacks and synergizes greatly with other Bob mods. However, it is more tinkertech on its own, but becomes less so as more Bob mods are stacked on top of each other. The more of them you have, the more capable you are of discarding the tinkertech approach in favor of true technologies provided by all related perks.

bobs_personal_equipment.name: Bob's Personal Equipment
bobs_personal_equipment.description: Gives you the ability to create and use all pieces of personal equipment added by Bob's Personal Equipment mod for Factorio. This perk stacks and synergizes greatly with other Bob mods. However, it is more tinkertech on its own, but becomes less so as more Bob mods are stacked on top of each other. The more of them you have, the more capable you are of discarding the tinkertech approach in favor of true technologies provided by all related perks.

bobs_power.name: Bob's Power
bobs_power.description: Gives you the ability to build new power structures added by the Bob's Power mod for Factorio. This perk stacks and synergizes greatly with other Bob mods. However, it is more tinkertech on its own, but becomes less so as more Bob mods are stacked on top of each other. The more of them you have, the more capable you are of discarding the tinkertech approach in favor of true technologies provided by all related perks.

bobs_tech.name: Bob's Tech
bobs_tech.description: This perk lets you learn theoretical facts about technology provided by other Bob's mods. It doesn't give you blueprints or specific applied knowledge about technology, but it fills in the gaps and allows you to integrate elements from other Bob's mods into different kinds of technologies. It also offers more non-tinkertech solutions to explore. You gain data slowly, but faster if you actually build and use things from Bob's mods perks.

bobs_vehicle_equipment.name: Bob's Vehicle Equipment
bobs_vehicle_equipment.description: Gives you the ability to build and use all equipment added by Bob's Vehicle Equipment mod for Factorio. This perk stacks and synergizes greatly with other Bob mods. However, it is more tinkertech on its own, but becomes less so as more Bob mods are stacked on top of each other. The more of them you have, the more capable you are of discarding the tinkertech approach in favor of true technologies provided by all related perks.

bobs_warfare.name: Bob's Warfare
bobs_warfare.description: Gives you the ability to create all warfare-related devices added by the Bob's Warfare mod for Factorio. This perk stacks and synergizes greatly with other Bob mods. However, it is more tinkertech on its own, but becomes less so as more Bob mods are stacked on top of each other. The more of them you have, the more capable you are of discarding the tinkertech approach in favor of true technologies provided by all related perks.

electric_weapons.name: Electric Weapons
electric_weapons.description: Perk inspired by the mod of the same name. It adds several blueprints of electric weapons to your mental compendium, along with in-depth scientific knowledge about how they work, and a degree of skill to use and modify them.

factory_planner.name: Factory Planner
factory_planner.description: This perk includes programs and simple devices ideal for planning your production in advance, specifying the recipes and machines that make up each assembly line. Basically tools for planning automated factory, enough computer science and design skills to actually create and use these programs.

gray_science.name: Gray Science
gray_science.description: You gain the ability to gradually acquire both theoretical and practical knowledge of Factorio-style military production. You start with basic stuff from the perk and need to build and use military devices, to push this ability further and further until you reach a limit of the perk decided by Factorio game content. Conflict using devices created by your play a big role in progressing this tech-tree. You need actual battles for the best returns.

green_science.name: Green Science
green_science.description: You gain the ability to gradually acquire both theoretical and practical knowledge of Factorio-style logistics. You start with basic stuff from the perk and need to build and use devices, as well as proactively utilise industrial logistics, to push this ability further and further until you reach a limit of the perk decided by Factorio game content.

infinite_source.name: Infinite Source
infinite_source.description: Once you buy this perk, you can choose one existing resource deposit nearby to apply a replenishing quality to it. This resource source will become endlessly replenishable, as long as you don't mine it too actively. There is a limit to how fast it will replenish, depending on the nature of the material, and there is an upper limit on how large or complex the targeted deposit can be. Coal replenishes much faster than something like redstone, for instance. The farther away the resource is from Factorio-style materials, the less effective this shaker effect becomes. This perk can be purchased multiple times, and its effects can be stockpiled in your inventory until you find a suitable target and spend them. Second and all subsequent purchases will cost only 400 CP.

krastorio.name: Krastorio
krastorio.description: You have a mental compendium of all blueprints for craftable items from the Krastorio mod for Factorio, and enough basic understanding of the theory to somewhat grasp this technology. However, if there is not enough contextual knowledge from other perks, there might be some blank spots and enforced tinkertech approaches in the technology. After all, you cannot reliably know and build higher levels of Factorio tech given by this perk if you don't know this tech in the first place. There will be some interesting consequences.

modular_turrets.name: Modular Turrets
modular_turrets.description: Perk inspired by the Modular Turrets mod for Factorio. You have the blueprints and enough skills to build, operate, and maintain turrets from the mod. You can go full tinkertech with them to make things very cheap, or go full true tech. Modularity is not the only flexibility these machines provide.

purple_science.name: Purple Science
purple_science.description: You gain the ability to gradually acquire both theoretical and practical knowledge of Factorio-style production. You start with basic stuff from the perk and need to build and use devices, as well as proactively produce variety of things using knowledge from this perk, to push this ability further and further until you reach a limit of the perk decided by Factorio game content.

pyanodons_addons.name: Pyanodons Addons
pyanodons_addons.description: This perk includes blueprints for all craftable items and machines from the Pyanodons mods, along with its various modules and addons. It also provides you with just enough scientific knowledge to somewhat understand your creations, as well as the skills to utilize, build, and reliably maintain this kind of technology.

red_science.name: Red Science
red_science.description: You gain the ability to gradually acquire both theoretical and practical knowledge of Factorio-style automation. You start with basic stuff from the perk and need to build and use devices, as well as proactively automate processes, to push this ability further and further until you reach a limit of the perk decided by Factorio game content.

repair_turret.name: Repair Turret
repair_turret.description: You are capable of creating a tower-like structure that uses energy beams to repair your structures, spending energy and repair kits to do so. This device can be built relatively easily if you go full tinkertech. You gain only basic scientific knowledge and one blueprint of a specific device from this perk, but you don't actually know how it works or if it's even possible to build it using completely mundane science and tech without cheating. It is inspired by the mod of the same name.

robot_army.name: Robot Army
robot_army.description: Perk inspired by the mod of the same name. It lets you manufacture and deploy automated robot soldiers to attack your foes and defend your factory! You have blueprints for craftable items from the mod, and you know how to program and command these machines.

shield_projector.name: Shield Projector
shield_projector.description: You are capable of creating a device that projects an energy shield in an arc - a wall that only needs energy to sustain itself. This device can be built relatively easily if you go full tinkertech. You gain only basic scientific knowledge and one blueprint of a specific device from this perk. It is inspired by the mod of the same name.

space_age.name: Space Age
space_age.description: You gain a mental compendium of theoretical scientific knowledge and blueprints of craftable items from the Space Age expansion pack for Factorio. Applying these blueprints and knowledge in practice will help you gain expertise in the usage and creation of technologies from this expansion at an incredibly rapid rate, gaining actual skills in leaps.

spidertron_extended.name: Spidertron Extended
spidertron_extended.description: This perk adds to your repertoire of blueprints: Spidertron MK2, Spidertron MK3, the Immolator, the Ghost Weaver, and Major Spidertron - more powerful upgraded versions of the Spidertron that can be crafted from the original, with enhanced firing capabilities, larger inventory size, equipment grid, radar coverage, mobility, and much more. It works weirdly and enforces tinkertech if you don't have access to the original Factorio Spidertron technology.

white_science.name: White Science
white_science.description: You gain the ability to gradually acquire both theoretical and practical knowledge of Factorio-style space technology. You start with basic stuff from the perk and need to build and use devices, as well as proactively explore and travel space using knowledge from this perk, to push this ability further and further until you reach a limit of the perk decided by Factorio game content. Space exploration and travel are needed to achieve the best returns for this perk.

yellow_science.name: Yellow Science
yellow_science.description: You gain the ability to gradually acquire both theoretical and practical knowledge of Factorio-style high tech and utility. You start with basic stuff from the perk and need to build and use devices, as well as proactively produce variety of things using knowledge from this perk, to push this ability further and further until you reach a limit of the perk decided by Factorio game content.

source_celestial_something_-_3_dyson_sph.description: Perks from Celestial Something - 3 Dyson Sphere Program.

building_upgrades.name: Building Upgrades
building_upgrades.description: This mental compendium of blueprints and the necessary knowledge allows you to create and implement building upgrades from the DSP game. It works much better with DSP technology. You can reverse engineer upgradable buildings using only this perk in theory, but it would be tedious, awkward, and would take a lot of time and testing. Infinite Tiers become more and more vague, incomplete, until unrecognizable in the compendium of this perk.

combat_upgrades.name: Combat Upgrades
combat_upgrades.description: This mental compendium of blueprints and the necessary knowledge allows you to create and implement combat upgrades from the DSP game. It works much better with DSP technology. You can reverse engineer upgradable items and structures using only this perk in theory, but it would be tedious, awkward, and would take a lot of time and testing. Infinite Tiers become more and more vague, incomplete, until unrecognizable in the compendium of this perk.

electromagnetism.name: Electromagnetism
electromagnetism.description: "Maxwell's equations poetically describe electricity and magnetism intertwining. With a deeper understanding, machines can be created for acquiring and using electrical energy with high efficiency." - This perk gives you scientific knowledge and blueprtints to create devices unlocked by the technology of the same name from the DSP game.

end_game_technology.name: End Game Technology
end_game_technology.description: This perk gives you a mental compendium of scientific knowledge and blueprints to understand, craft, and maintain all devices and structures of Tier Thirteen and above technology from the DSP game. You can obtain this perk without perks for previous Tiers, but there will be expected holes in your understanding. You can reroll this perk for free.

exploration_upgrades.name: Exploration Upgrades
exploration_upgrades.description: This perk gives you the thinker ability to search for and view resources around you. It cannot highlight every kind of resources - only works best with DSP and related types of materials. This perk can be purchased four times in total, costing 100 CP more for each purchase.

icarus.name: Icarus
icarus.description: You have the ability to build the basic Icarus mecha from DSP. You have the blueprint and extensive skills to maintain and use this machine, but you don't have complete knowledge of its inner workings. It has high tinkertech cheating potential to cut corners to create this mecha.

mecha_upgrades_i.name: Mecha Upgrades I
mecha_upgrades_i.description: You gain blueprints and skills to implement Tier One upgrades for the Icarus Mecha. It includes a basic level of scientific understanding, but it is very limited. Yes, it can be tinkertech-cheated relatively easily.

mecha_upgrades_ii.name: Mecha Upgrades II
mecha_upgrades_ii.description: You gain blueprints and skills to implement Tier Two upgrades for the Icarus Mecha. It includes a basic level of scientific understanding, but it is very limited. Yes, it can be tinkertech-cheated relatively easily. You can buy this perk without having previous ones, but there will be expected gaps in your knowledge and abilities. You can reroll this perk for free.

acquire_skills.name: Acquire Skills
acquire_skills.description: After buying this perk, you can choose any skill from the list of existing skills in the RimWorld game. You will have this chosen skill in reserve, waiting to be used by you. You can apply it to yourself or another person you touch to gain or give two levels of the skill (maximum of 20). It takes a few minutes to apply chosen skill. This perk can be rolled multiple times.

alpha_genes.name: Alpha Genes
alpha_genes.description: You gain a mental compendium of genes from Alpha Genes mod, instructions on how to produce and apply them effectively. However, it is useless, if you don't have skills or/and machines to actually use these blueprints. You need Biotech perk from RimWorld or similiar to apply knowledge effectively.

anomaly.name: Anomaly
anomaly.description: This perk provides you with the necessary scientific base, basic skills and blueprints for specific pieces of technology/projects to create items and do various things from the Anomaly DLC for the RimWorld game. All potential infohazards from the perk are hidden from you, if it would hurt you to know.

auto_dissector.name: Auto Dissector
auto_dissector.description: "Automated surgical device has been added, which can help you precisely remove diseased organs or detach any bionic implants you deem unnecessary. It can also be used for processing prisoners, allowing for the bulk extraction of desired body parts." You gain one such machine from the Auto Dissector mod along with a thick detailed manual on how to operate, maintain and build more of the same. Good luck figuring it out!

biotech.name: Biotech
biotech.description: This perk provides you with the necessary scientific base, basic skills, and blueprints for specific pieces of technology/projects to create items and do various projects from the Biotech DLC for the RimWorld game.

gene_fabrication.name: Gene Fabrication
gene_fabrication.description: "Are you tired of trying to get a specific gene after hours of grinding quests, extracting, and trading? With massive mod lists with hundreds of new genes, is it even worth losing your sanity over it? Now there is a solution. With the Gene Fabrication bench, you can now craft genes on your own, without the need for the constant grind." You gain one such machine from the mod of the same name along with a thick detailed manual on how to operate, maintain and build more of the same. Good luck figuring it out!

glittertech_expansion.name: Glittertech Expansion
glittertech_expansion.description: You gain ability to create various devices from Glittertech Expansion mod for RimWorld along with some basic understanding of this technology.

hacking_expansion.name: Hacking Expansion
hacking_expansion.description: You gain a mental compendium of blueprints for devices from Hacking Expansion mod for RimWorld along with basic skills to actually utilise and build these devices effectively.

ideology.name: Ideology
ideology.description: This perk provides you with the necessary scientific base, basic skills, degree of supernatural ability and blueprints for specific pieces of technology/projects to create items and do various things from the Ideology DLC for the RimWorld game. All potential infohazards from the perk are hidden from you, if it would hurt you to know. This perk makes you more socially adept and more talented in all talented in social sciences.

industrial_projects.name: Industrial Projects
industrial_projects.description: You gain knowledge and all the necessary skills to build and create things by completing Industrial Research Projects in the RimWorld game. It includes both specific blueprints and basic level of skills. Doesn't include DLCs content.

integrated_implants.name: Integrated Implants
integrated_implants.description: You gain a mental compendium of blueprints from Integrated Implants mod, instructions on how to produce and apply them effectively. However, it is basically useless, if you don't have skills or/and machines to actually use these blueprints. You have a lot of knowledge and needed skills to build stuff, but not the tools.

lost_factory_mechanoids.name: Lost Factory Mechanoids
lost_factory_mechanoids.description: This perk gives you the ability to create a small factory project for the production of machines and devices from the Lost Factory Mechanoids and Mechanoid Upgrades mods for RimWorld. It includes a comprehensive mental compendium of technical knowledge for the items you create.

medieval_projects.name: Medieval Projects
medieval_projects.description: You gain knowledge and all the necessary skills to build and create things by completing Medieval Research Projects in the RimWorld game. It includes both specific blueprints and basic level of skills. Doesn't include DLCs content.

neolithic_projects.name: Neolithic Projects
neolithic_projects.description: You gain knowledge and all the necessary skills to build and create things by completing Neolithic Research Projects in the RimWorld game. It includes both specific blueprints and basic level of skills. Doesn't include DLCs content.

obtain_traits.name: Obtain Traits
obtain_traits.description: After buying this perk, you can choose any trait from the list of existing traits in the RimWorld game. You will have this one chosen trait in reserve, waiting to be used by you. You can apply it to yourself or to another person you touch. It takes a few minutes to apply the chosen trait. The effect causes permanent changes to the target. Same traits do not stack, but may cause unpredictable consequences when applied. This perk can be rolled multiple times. Beware of unintended psychological/physiological effects.

odyssey.name: Odyssey
odyssey.description: This perk provides you with the necessary scientific base, basic skills and blueprints for specific pieces of technology/projects to create items and do various things from the Odyssey DLC for the RimWorld game.

redistribute_passion.name: Redistribute Passion
redistribute_passion.description: This perk gives you three metaphorical charges, which you can use to temporarily gain Passion towards some skill from the list of existing in RimWorld game. You can invest one charge to become Interested or two to gain Burning status. It doesn't actually make you more skillful, but it allows you to take pleasure in doing something and provides a multiplier on experience gain. Charges reset every 24 hours and need to be re-applied. You can also apply them to other people, but they only return to you after 24 hours have passed. You must use all three charges at the same time when activating this perk. Beware of unintended psychological effects.

rimsenal_pack.name: Rimsenal Pack
rimsenal_pack.description: You gain a mental compendium of blueprints for items, structures and even some creatures from the Rimsenal Pack of mods for RimWorld, along with the skills needed to practically utilize and create these items effectively. It also includes incredible talent for utilizing weapons for their main purpose. It contains only basic background scientific knowledge. Easily turned into tinkertech.

royalty.name: Royalty
royalty.description: This perk provides you with the necessary scientific base, basic skills, degree of psycasting potential and blueprints for specific pieces of technology/projects to create items and do various things from the Royalty DLC for the RimWorld game.

spacer_projects.name: Spacer Projects
spacer_projects.description: You gain knowledge and all the necessary skills to build and create things by completing Spacer Research Projects in the RimWorld game. It includes both specific blueprints and basic level of skills. Doesn't include DLCs content.

vanilla_furniture_expanded.name: Vanilla Furniture Expanded
vanilla_furniture_expanded.description: You gain a mental compendium of blueprints for craftable items from the Vanilla Furniture Expanded series of mods for RimWorld, along with the skills needed to practically utilize and create these items effectively. However, it doesn't include any in-depth scientific knowledge.

vanilla_genetics_expanded.name: Vanilla Genetics Expanded
vanilla_genetics_expanded.description: You gain a mental compendium of blueprints for craftable items from the Vanilla Genetics Expanded mod for RimWorld, along with the skills needed to practically utilize and create these items effectively. However, it doesn't include any in-depth scientific knowledge and is tinkertech, if you don't have Biotech perk from RimWorld category.

vanilla_vehicles_expande.name: Vanilla Vehicles Expande
vanilla_vehicles_expande.description: You gain a mental compendium of blueprints for craftable items from the Vanilla Vehicles Expande series of mods for RimWorld, along with the skills needed to practically utilize and create these items effectively. It also includes some degree of talent for any vehicle-related mechanic fields.

vanilla_weapons_expande.name: Vanilla Weapons Expande
vanilla_weapons_expande.description: You gain a mental compendium of blueprints for craftable items from the Vanilla Weapons Expanded series of mods for RimWorld, along with the skills and knowledge needed to practically utilize and create these items effectively.

active_countermeasures.name: Active Countermeasures
active_countermeasures.description: "The best defense is a good offense." This perks make you an expert in planning and building relatively primitive Sentinel Point-Defense systems.

alien_topography.name: Alien Topography
alien_topography.description: "Civilizations flourish in locations that promotes growth, and by analyzing where the majority of pre-FTL settlements thrive we can gain more out of our colonies."

archaeostudies_tree.name: Archaeostudies Tree
archaeostudies_tree.description: This perk gives you the ability to research and discover technologies from the Archaeostudies Tree of the Stellaris game unnaturally fast. Progression is semi-random, utilizes a card shuffle approach, and requires you to create and use various devices, explore the technologies of others and being proactive. Your actions make details from some technologies more probable to appear than others the next time inspiration strikes. You can pay an additional 300 CP (half the price of the perk) now or the next time you roll this perk to instantly unlock a portion of the tree. You can do this as many times as you want if you have points to spare. Each time, it grants you an immediate leap in knowledge, blueprints, and skills, covering a few of the lowest technologies still ahead of you in this tree (usually between one and two). It doesn't include Events.

baol_organic_plant.name: Baol Organic Plant
baol_organic_plant.description: "The Baol Organism had a unique way of producing tools. Given the species' relative slowness, they would simply grow them out of organic matter in locations that were half orchard, half factory. With the proper genetic adjustments, we could also grow various commodities and tools alongside our regular crops."

biology_event_technologies.name: Biology Event Technologies
biology_event_technologies.description: This perk gives you one randomly chosen Biology Event Technologies to learn blueprints, general theory, and gain skills to apply this discovery. If the technology you rolled requires another Event Technology to function, you get that one instead. Can be rolled several times. Rolling something you already have gives you nothing, but you don't lose any CP.

biology_tree.name: Biology Tree
biology_tree.description: This perk gives you the ability to research and discover technologies from the Biology Tree of the Stellaris game unnaturally fast. Your actions make details from some technologies more probable to appear than others the next time inspiration strikes. You can pay an additional 250 CP (half the price of the perk) now or the next time you roll this perk to instantly unlock a portion of the tree. It doesn't include Starter Technologies and Events.

chemical_thrusters.name: Chemical Thrusters
chemical_thrusters.description: "Simple yet moderately effective chemical thrusters that rely on combustible propellant to function." You have a mental compendium of blueprints and instructions on how to plan, build, operate, and maintain chemical thrusters of a future civilization level technology. However, you have no practical skills.

computing_tree.description: This perk gives you the ability to research and discover technologies from the Computing Tech Tree of the Stellaris game unnaturally fast. corvettes.name: Corvettes
corvettes.description: "The Corvette is the most basic military ship, armed and ready in the event of hostile contacts." You can build, maintain, and operate such a base with suitable tools on hand, but you lack an extensive theoretical background about why it is constructed this way.

cybrex_mining_hub.name: Cybrex Mining Hub
cybrex_mining_hub.description: "To build their ring world, the Cybrex relied on highly efficient mining drones to survey and harvest orbital resources. Cybrex-made memory chips and sensors could outfit our own mining drones, so that we might put their millennia old algorithms to good use."

deep_space_defenses.name: Deep Space Defenses
deep_space_defenses.description: "This will enable the construction of defensive deep space platforms to protect our Starbases." You know how to build, operate, maintain and modify simple defensive deep space platforms.

deflectors.name: Deflectors
deflectors.description: "Energy deflector screens can stop a limited amount of incoming enemy fire before overloading. Their main drawback is that they consume large amounts of power." You gain insight into Deflector technology, theory behind it and several blueprints to apply it.

energy_burster.name: Energy Burster
energy_burster.description: "Fires bio-projectiles that emit bursts of energy upon impact, subtly enhancing the maneuverability of our vessels." Blueprints and skills to grow/create such devices are in your mental library.

first_league_filing_offices.name: First League Filing Offices
first_league_filing_offices.description: "The sprawling empire of the First League dwarfed our own at its peak, and relied on implacable bureaucracy to keep the wheels of the state in motion. The quantic filing arrays they used afforded them unprecedented efficiency in the sorting and storing of documents."

fission_power.name: Fission Power
fission_power.description: "This energy source generates power for ships through induced fission, but it also produces harmful nuclear waste." You gain the equivalent of higher education in the field of fission power. Your skills and knowledge are average by the standards of this futuristic society. However, you have many gaps in your knowledge and context beyond the fission power field.

flak_battery.name: Flak Battery
flak_battery.description: "Gun batteries that fire shrapnel rounds at close range. They are particularly lethal to enemy strike craft, but can also defend against missiles." You have a mental compendium of blueprints and instructions on how to plan, build, operate, and maintain flak battery weaponary of a future civilization level technology. However, you have no practical skills.

fruit_gardens.name: Fruit Gardens
fruit_gardens.description: "Vacuum gardens full of bio-engineered fruits, genetically enhanced to attract spaceborne fauna." You know how to build such gardens and bio-engineer a variety of organisms for them.

high-energy_capacitors.name: High-Energy Capacitors
high-energy_capacitors.description: "Capacitors capable of storing vast amounts of energy is one of the cornerstones for any modern civilization." You posess a theoretical knowledge and a few variations of blueprints to make High-Energy Capacitors, and a degree of skill to produce and use them

holo-entertainment.name: Holo-Entertainment
holo-entertainment.description: "The latest in holographic entertainment. Entire worlds built out of photons and energy fields." You are an average-skilled expert in holo-engineering and design.

hyperspace_travel.name: Hyperspace Travel
hyperspace_travel.description: "Like the strands of a spider web, the extra-dimensional realm of hyperspace runs between the gravity wells of most stars. Faster-than-light travel is theoretically possible along these hyperlanes." You gain insight into the theory of hyperspace travel and a few blueprints of devices to experimentally prove parts of it.

industrial_agriculture.name: Industrial Agriculture
industrial_agriculture.description: "Large-scale industrial farms growing nutrient-rich produce allow a civilization to increase its population manifold." You have the expertise of someone who used to run and oversee the construction of such large-scale industrial farms.

industrial_base.name: Industrial Base
industrial_base.description: "The basic industrial infrastructure that is required to become a spacefaring civilization." You have an extensive theoretical base and exceptional talent in planning and building basic industrial infrastructure at the level of a future society. Although, no specific blueprints.

industry_tree.name: Industry Tree
industry_tree.description: This perk gives you the ability to research and discover technologies from the Industry Tree of the Stellaris game unnaturally fast. Progression is semi-random, utilizes a card shuffle approach, and requires you to create and use various devices, explore the technologies of others and being proactive. Your actions make details from some technologies more probable to appear than others the next time inspiration strikes. You can pay an additional 300 CP now or the next time you roll this perk to instantly unlock a portion of the tree. You can do this as many times as you want if you have points to spare. Each time, it grants you an immediate leap in knowledge, blueprints, and skills, covering a few of the lowest technologies still ahead of you in this tree (usually between one and two). It doesn't include Starter Technologies and Events.

interplanetary_commerce.name: Interplanetary Commerce
interplanetary_commerce.description: "With new planetary markets comes new opportunities for commerce. Business will be booming." You are an average-skilled expert in interplanetary commerce.

interplanetary_expeditionary_forces.name: Interplanetary Expeditionary Forces
interplanetary_expeditionary_forces.description: "The invasion of another world is a staggering enterprise. There are immense logistical challenges that must be overcome before we can muster our first interplanetary armies." You have education in military logistics of interplanetary forces.

irassian_naval_yards.name: Irassian Naval Yards
irassian_naval_yards.description: "The Irassian astronaval tradition was unmatched in their time. Their shipyards produced a constant stream of ships for their navy and merchant fleets, which would ultimately be their downfall. With so many ships, and such a high reliance on them, the Irassians were powerless to quarantine the disease that would claim their empire."

leviathan_tech_genesis.name: Leviathan Tech Genesis
leviathan_tech_genesis.description: "Utilizing the received knowledge seized from Leviathans, we now have access to new improvements for our frames."

lost_building_methods.name: Lost Building Methods
lost_building_methods.description: "Any civilization with a long enough history has examples of great wonders built by forgotten ancients which can no longer be replicated. Luckily for us we have documented these great ancients when they appeared on pre-FTL worlds."

mass_drivers.description: "These electromagnetic projectile launchers use magnets to accelerate armor-piercing rounds towards targets at high speeds." red_lasers.description: "Laser weapons fire focused beams of light at targets, causing damage through the generation of intense heat." You are a skillful engineer specializing in the maintenance and construction of Red Laser weapons.

scientific_method.description: "Testable predictions of observable phenomena." - You gain the equivalent of higher education in a field of scientific methodology. Your skills and knowledge are average by the standards of this futuristic society. However, you have many blank spaces for knowledge and context lying beond scientific methodology field.

sociocultural_history.description: "An understanding of a shared past is necessary in order to make any significant strides into the future." You are an expert historian and monument builder of average skill from future society.

space_exploration.name: Space Exploration
space_exploration.description: "The Science Ship is used as a base of operations for a top Scientist, ready to explore the vastness of space." starbase_construction.name: Starbase Construction
starbase_construction.description: "A centralized space installation built in close orbit around the system primary is necessary to make full use of the resources in a star system." subspace_drive.name: Subspace Drive
subspace_drive.description: "An insight born of a desperate desire to leave our home, these Subspace Drive engines were designed to facilitate limited interstellar travel. You gain a blueprint and just enough skill to start and complete the Subspace Drive engine megaproject, but nearly no theoretical context beyond needed.

synaptic_structures.name: Synaptic Structures
synaptic_structures.description: "Through the development of macroscopic synaptic nodes, the will of the Hive will be strengthened." You have blueprints on how to build and instructions on how to operate various synaptic structures of hive-mind-type future society.

vector_lock_cannon.name: Vector Lock Cannon
vector_lock_cannon.description: "Biologically enhanced projectiles are fired, countering evasive maneuvers and striking agile targets." Blueprints and skills to grow/create such devices are in your mental library.

vultaum_reality_computer.description: "The reality computers of the Vultaums were unique processing units, dedicated to analyzing existence itself, not quite through physics, but rather by trying to reverse engineer reality's source code and find the glitch that would finally allow the Vultaums to take down the simulation where they believed they lived."

weavers.name: Weavers
weavers.description: "Building on the foundations of early bio-engineering, Weavers are crafted to balance agility with increased combat capabilities." Blueprints and skills to grow/create such devices are in your mental library along with average skills to pilot one.

yuht_astronomical_interferometer.name: Yuht Astronomical Interferometer
yuht_astronomical_interferometer.description: "The Yuht were a paradoxical society, obsessed with the idea of finding other sentient species, yet refusing to accept that they were not alone. They were so focused on disproving any claim of alien life, that their bias found a way into their technology. However, with the proper modifications and calibrations, we could certainly fix their powerful detection arrays."

zroni_storm_caster.name: Zroni Storm Caster
zroni_storm_caster.description: "Zro is a fascinating element, prone to chaotic bursts of energy. We believe that with the right artifacts, we could use it to fuel spatial storms over entire solar systems."

source_celestial_something_-_6_ark_survi.description: Perks from Celestial Something - 6 ARK_ Survival Evolved.

aberration_engrams.name: Aberration Engrams
aberration_engrams.description: Gain access to recipes from all Engrams in Aberration DLC for ARK: Survival Evolved. Includes basic skills to use all creations.

engrams_creation.name: Engrams Creation
engrams_creation.description: You have insight into the creation of Engrams and the method of their implantation into the minds of others. These Engrams let you share recipes and blueprints you know with other people. They even allow them to craft things that are not usually craftable - tinkertech and similiar recipes obtained from your perks. However, there are limitations on how complex an Engram can be, so you cannot share the ability to build all types of technology. This perk works better for technology from ARK perks, but you can figure out how to encode creations from other perks you possess. People can use implanted Engram to craft whatever technology you included into it.

high_engrams.description: Gain access to recipes from all Engrams above level 50 and up to level 100 in ARK: Survival Evolved base game. Includes basic skills to use all creations.

low_engrams.name: Low Engrams
low_engrams.description: Gain access to recipes from all Engrams up to level 50 in ARK: Survival Evolved base game. Includes basic skills to use all creations.

scorched_earth_engrams.name: Scorched Earth Engrams
scorched_earth_engrams.description: Gain access to recipes from all Engrams in Scorched Earth DLC for ARK: Survival Evolved. Includes basic skills to use all creations.

tek_recipes.name: Tek Recipes
tek_recipes.description: Gain access to recipes from all Tekgrams in ARK: Survival Evolved base game. Includes basic skills to use all creations and scientific understanding of technology.

tekgrams_creation.name: Tekgrams Creation
tekgrams_creation.description: You have insight into the creation of Tekgrams and the method of their implantation into the minds of others. They even enable them to craft things that are not usually craftable - tinkertech and similar recipes obtained from your perks. This perk essentially provides an upgrade for Engrams, allowing you to share the capability to build any technology with others - one Tekgram at a time! This perk requires Engrams to be purchased to function. If you don't have it, rolling Tekgrams will automatically buy Engrams, provided you have enough CP to afford it.

bottomless_shimmer_bucket.name: Bottomless Shimmer Bucket
bottomless_shimmer_bucket.description: This mysterious magical item can be used to pour out infinite amounts of Shimmer. This is a shiny, lavender-colored, pearlescent liquid with some rather special properties.

calamity_expansion.name: Calamity Expansion
calamity_expansion.description: You can craft all types of items from the Calamity mod (including addons) for Terraria game, including unobtainable and hardcore ones. They have their special properties preserved due to the supernatural component of the perk. You can use normal variants of materials to craft them, but this will make them more like tinkertech in a negative way. Ideally, you should choose variations of materials from the Terraria game or at least similar enough resources from other sources to get the best results. This perk only gives boost to skills, while you are working on things included into the perk. But you still can slowly learn some mundane things from exposure to crafting process.

more_life.name: More Life
more_life.description: This perk grants you the equivalent of one Life Crystal or Fruit use, depending on how many times you have already rolled and bought this perk. You can purchase this perk multiple times - up to 35 times, to be exact. First, you go through 15 Life Crystal equivalents, then through 20 Life Fruit equivalents. Each time, it slightly increases your life energy and your ability to survive damage.

You can hold this effect in storage until you find a suitable place to target. You can buy this perk multiple times, with a 300 CP discount after the first purchase, stacking these held activations of the ability to use later. The first purchase of the perk grants you encyclopedic knowledge of the Corruption biome.

the_hallow_spreads.name: The Hallow Spreads
the_hallow_spreads.description: This perk allows you to generate the Hallow biome from Terraria, transforming the area a few kilometers around you. thorium_mod.name: Thorium Mod
thorium_mod.description: You can craft all types of items from the Thorium mod for Terraria game, including unobtainable and hardcore ones. They have their special properties preserved due to the supernatural component of the perk. You can use normal variants of materials to craft them, but this will make them more like tinkertech in a negative way. Ideally, you should choose variations of materials from the Terraria game or at least similar enough resources from other sources to get the best results. This perk only gives boost to skills, while you are working on things included into the perk. But you still can slowly learn some mundane things from exposure to crafting process.

we_are_rich.name: We Are Rich!
we_are_rich.description: This perk allows you to spawn twelve full chests containing different coins, gems, and bars in targeted locations without causing any damage. If there is not enough space, fewer chests will spawn. They contain currency and Terraria-type resources inside them (giving them unique properties). You can hold onto this effect to activate it when a suitable target is found, and you can stack stored effects indefinitely. This perk can be purchased multiple times. The quantity of specific materials inside the chests depends on their rarity and usefulness in the game. There will be more early-game materials in these chests than late-game ones. It includes materials from mods, if you have perks for them.

source_celestial_something_-_8_grim_dawn.description: Perks from Celestial Something - 8 Grim Dawn.

aetherial_lore.name: Aetherial Lore
aetherial_lore.description: "Foolishly and greedily did the arcanists of Cairn delve into the magical veil known as the Aether, never once suspecting that something was looking back. The Aetherials descended upon Cairn in what is now known as the Grim Dawn, possessing countless humans and butchering the rest. Most despicably of all, they began raising the fallen as mutated undead creatures, mindless foot soldiers for their invasion. Their very presence on Cairn is enough to mutate the wildlife, turning once docile creatures into vicious monstrosities. But most strange of all is their apparent hatred for Chthonians, as they will battle against the horrors from the Void at every opportunity." You gain a deep insight into Aetherial lore, the ability to actually call upon these powers to produce various effects, and even thin out boundaries to cause a version of 'Grim Dawn' in your current reality (not sure why you would do that). The infohazardous knowledge granted by this perk is hidden from you; if it would harm you, you won't perceive it. Be wary - dabbling in such powers too much might attract the attention of something bigger on the other side, even if you intended otherwise, simply because you were not careful.

arcanist_path.name: Arcanist Path
arcanist_path.description: "To Arcanists, the manifestation of magic is not some unexplainable mystery or the will of the gods, but a science meant to be unraveled. This pursuit of knowledge drives all Arcanists, always eager to discover a new technique to make their namesake. Arcanists warp the mysterious aether and elements to their will, creating devastating demonstrations of power that rival small armies. However, such raw force leaves little in terms of defense." You gain starting skills and ability to progress on the path of Arcanist Mastery from Grim Dawn game unusually fast.

augment_making_recipes.name: Augment Making Recipes
augment_making_recipes.description: "Augments are enchanted powders, tinctures and poisons that can be used to empower weapons, rings, and amulets. An item may have only one augment on it at any given time, and applying a new augment overwrites the old one. Salvaging or dismantling an augmented item does not return the augment." You gain ability to craft all augments from the game, apply them effectively. You can even tweak recipes slightly or use auguments in creative ways. However, you only have high skills, deep insight, and mystical powers when creating something from these recipes. Although, over time, some mundane or even more supernatural pieces of skills and knowledge might stick to you through the practice of crafting these items.

blueprints_accessories.name: Blueprints: Accessories
blueprints_accessories.description: You gain the mental compendium of all blueprints, which can be found and collected in the game, for Aaccessorie and the ability to build them. However, over time, some mundane or even more supernatural pieces of skills and knowledge might stick to you through the practice of crafting these items.
